104#: How long stale data stays on the board before we admit we are offline. 

105STALE_AFTER_SECONDS = 15 * 60 

106FRAME_INTERVAL = 0.5 

107#: Frame interval while a holiday fly-by is crossing the panel (#237). At 

108#: FRAME_INTERVAL a sprite would jump ~10px a frame; this is ~1px. Only for 

109#: the few seconds something is moving -- the board idles at 2fps otherwise. 

110ANIMATION_FRAME_INTERVAL = 0.05 

111#: The favourite's share of ``rotate_seconds`` while other followed games take 

112#: turns during its intermission or held final (#260): long enough to read 

113#: the score, short enough that the games actually being played get the time. 

114FAVOURITE_QUICK_TURN = 0.5 

115#: The intermission stats screen (``intermission``): how long each page of the table stays up, and 

116#: how often the stats are fetched again while the favourite's game sits in an intermission. 

117INTERMISSION_PAGE_SECONDS = 6.0 

118INTERMISSION_STATS_REFRESH_SECONDS = 60.0 

119#: A failed or empty stats fetch is tried again after this long. 

120INTERMISSION_STATS_RETRY_SECONDS = 15.0 

121#: The favourite's season schedule changes rarely; this is plenty. 

122SCHEDULE_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 

123#: Standings don't change intra-day except right after games finish. 

124STANDINGS_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 

125#: A team's jersey numbers never change intra-season; points change only 

126#: when that team plays, at most a few times a week (#124). 

127ROSTER_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 

128#: The upcoming game's head-to-head tally (#157) only moves when another 

129#: meeting between the same two teams finishes -- days or weeks apart. 

130SEASON_SERIES_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 

131#: Season stat leaders (#201) move only when a game finishes. 

132LEADERS_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 

133#: How much a new lux reading moves the smoothed value, 0-1. Low on purpose: 

134#: this is what keeps a cloud passing over a window, or a hand briefly 

135#: covering the sensor, from visibly flickering the panel. 

136BRIGHTNESS_SMOOTHING = 0.3 

137#: How long each scene stays up in ``--demo`` (#47). 

138DEMO_SCENE_SECONDS = 4.0 

139 

140#: Scene kinds whose table scrolls over the slot (#280, #296). 

141SCROLLING_KINDS = ("conference_leaders", "division", "wildcard") 

142#: How long the admin page's address stays up after the board first gets a 

143#: default route -- on boot (Ethernet or saved Wi-Fi) or after a join (#293). 

144ADDRESS_SHOW_SECONDS = 60.0 

145#: How long a looked-up IP is reused, so the lookup isn't made every frame. 

146IP_CACHE_SECONDS = 5.0 

147#: Written by scoreboard-setup-ap while the board's own first-boot WiFi 

148#: AP is up (#131 follow-up); its mere presence means the ap_setup scene 

149#: overrides everything else, so a phone that can only reach the board over 

150#: that AP always sees how to join it. /run, matching the script's own 

151#: choice -- never survives a reboot stale. 

152AP_SETUP_STATE_PATH = Path("/run/scoreboard-setup-ap-state.json") 

153#: Written by scoreboard-setup-ap's pre-AP-mode scan (#132) -- a JSON 

154#: array of nearby SSIDs, cached from a snapshot taken moments before the AP 

155#: came up (this chip can't scan while its own AP is active). Read by the 

156#: setup page to render its network picker; the page always offers a plain 

157#: text field alongside it too, since that snapshot can miss a network. 

158AP_SCAN_STATE_PATH = Path("/run/scoreboard-setup-ap-networks.json") 

159#: Written by the setup page (#132) when someone submits a network choice -- 

160#: the hand-off point for #133's still-to-be-built join flow to read from. 

161#: This app only ever writes it; it never touches iwd/iwctl itself. 

162AP_SUBMISSION_STATE_PATH = Path("/run/scoreboard-setup-submission.json") 

163#: Written by WifiJoinAttempt (#133) while/after acting on a submission -- 

164#: "attempting"/"connected"/"failed" -- and read by _wifi_join_scene() to 

165#: show it on the panel, the feedback channel #133 decided on since the AP 

166#: teardown needed to attempt the join kills the phone's own connection to 

167#: whatever HTTP request submitted it. /run, same non-surviving-a-reboot 

168#: convention as every other AP-setup-mode state file. 

169WIFI_JOIN_OUTCOME_PATH = Path("/run/scoreboard-wifi-join-state.json") 

170#: Marker written by _on_panel_next() while the setup page's display check 

171#: (#172) has a hardware_mapping trial running -- i.e. it changed 

172#: [panel].hardware_mapping and restarted the service to try the new value, 

173#: and "yes, it's working" (_on_panel_confirm()) hasn't cleared it yet. 

174#: Its existence is the gate; its content is the JSON list of mappings 

175#: tried so far this trial, so the page can say when a full lap of the 

176#: candidates has gone by with nothing lit (wiring, not the setting). The 

177#: current mapping itself is read fresh from self.settings.panel. 

178#: hardware_mapping, which the restart this file exists to survive already 

179#: reloads from disk. /run, same never-survives-a-reboot 

180#: convention as every other AP-setup-mode state file: a full reboot always 

181#: starts over at whatever's actually configured, not a half-finished trial 

182#: from hours ago. 

183HW_MAPPING_TRIAL_PATH = Path("/run/scoreboard-hw-mapping-trial.json") 

184#: Characters the de-facto WIFI: QR-code format requires backslash-escaped 

185#: inside SSID/password fields -- unescaped, any of these would end the 

186#: field early or corrupt the payload for a strict parser. 

187_QR_SPECIAL_CHARS = re.compile(r'([\\;,:"])') 

188 

189 

190def _qr_escape(value: str) -> str: 

191 return _QR_SPECIAL_CHARS.sub(r"\\\1", value)

194def _restart_scoreboard_service() -> None: 

195 """Fire-and-forget ``systemctl restart scoreboard.service`` (#172). 

196 

197 [panel] settings including hardware_mapping never hot-reload (see 

198 config.py's Settings.save() and reload_config_if_changed()'s own 

199 docstring) -- an actual process restart is what rebuilds RGBMatrix with 

200 a newly-saved mapping. Backgrounded on its own thread, same pattern as 

201 admin_server.py's _reboot_board(): the 

202 HTTP response announcing "trying <mapping> now" must reach the phone 

203 before this process might be torn down to restart, not block on the 

204 restart finishing first. Restart=always/RestartSec=10 in the unit file 

205 only governs an unplanned crash; an explicit `restart` here stops and 

206 starts right away, no 10s delay. 

207 """ 

208 

209 def _run() -> None: 

210 try: 

211 subprocess.run( 

212 ["systemctl", "restart", "scoreboard.service"], 

213 check=False, 

214 capture_output=True, 

215 timeout=30, 

216 ) 

217 except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError) as exc: 

218 log.warning("Could not restart scoreboard.service: %s", exc) 

219 

220 threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True, name="hw-mapping-restart").start() 

221

245@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) 

246class Scene: 

247 """What the board should show right now. 

248 

249 ``kind`` is one of ``game`` (live or final scoreboard), ``goal``, 

250 ``goal_detail``, ``penalty``, ``three_stars``, ``intermission``, ``countdown``, ``preview``, 

251 ``standings``, 

252 ``conference_leaders``, ``division``, ``wildcard``, ``matchup``, ``matchup_meetings``, 

253 ``leaders``, ``scores``, ``clock``, ``christmas_tree``, ``thanksgiving``, ``no_games``, 

254 ``connecting``, ``no_data``, ``ap_setup``, ``wifi_join``, ``address``. 

255 

256 Football mode (football) adds the ``fb_`` kinds listed in ``football.mode.FB_SCENE_KINDS``, 

257 documented in ``football_screen.md`` rather than ``screens.md``. 

258 """ 

259 

260 kind: str 

261 game: Game | None = None 

262 standings: tuple[StandingsRow, ...] | None = None 

263 #: Set only for ``matchup`` (#157) -- oriented to ``game``'s own 

264 #: away/home sides, as the API returns it. 

265 season_series: SeasonSeriesRecord | None = None 

266 #: Set only for ``matchup``/``matchup_meetings`` (#168) -- the finished 

267 #: meetings from the favourite's side, oldest first. 

268 meetings: tuple[MeetingResult, ...] = () 

269 #: Set only for ``leaders`` (#201) -- the favourite's own top players. 

270 leaders: TeamLeaders | None = None 

271 #: Set only for ``scores`` (#269) -- one grid page of today's games. 

272 games: tuple[Game, ...] = () 

273 #: Set only for ``goal_detail`` -- who scored, and their/their 

274 #: assisters' season totals (#122). 

275 goal_event: GoalEvent | None = None 

276 #: Set only for ``goal`` -- the scoring team's abbreviation, for the 

277 #: screen's colour and name (#265). 

278 goal_team: str = "" 

279 #: Set only for ``penalty`` (#340) -- the call being announced. 

280 penalty: Penalty | None = None 

281 #: Set only for ``three_stars`` -- the hockey's three stars of a finished 

282 #: favourite game, ranked, per-game stats (#156). 

283 stars: tuple[Star, ...] | None = None 

284 #: Set only for ``intermission`` -- the favourite's game stats table, and the page tick (the 

285 #: renderer takes it modulo its own page count). 

286 stats: GameStats | None = None 

287 stats_page: int = 0 

288 #: Set only for ``ap_setup`` (#131 follow-up) -- the board's own 

289 #: first-boot WiFi AP, so a phone can join and finish setup. ``None`` 

290 #: password means the AP came up open, not WPA2-protected. 

291 ap_ssid: str | None = None 

292 ap_password: str | None = None 

293 #: Precomputed QR module grid (row-major, True = dark module), or 

294 #: ``None`` when the payload didn't fit any QR version, or `qrcode` 

295 #: itself failed for some other reason -- the scene still shows 

296 #: SSID/password as text either way, same graceful-degradation 

297 #: precedent as LightSensor/resolve_timezone elsewhere in this app. 

298 ap_qr_matrix: tuple[tuple[bool, ...], ...] | None = None 

299 #: Set only for ``wifi_join`` (#133) -- "attempting"/"connected"/"failed", 

300 #: and the SSID that outcome is about. 

301 wifi_join_status: str | None = None 

302 wifi_join_ssid: str | None = None 

303 #: Rows above the playoff line on a standings table (#298), or None for no line. 

304 playoff_cut: int | None = None 

305 #: Set only for ``address`` (#293) -- where the admin page is reachable. 

306 address_ip: str | None = None 

307 address_port: int = 80 

308 #: The board's mDNS name (``<host>.local``, #292), None when unknown. 

309 address_name: str | None = None 

310 address_qr: tuple[tuple[bool, ...], ...] | None = None 

311 #: Set only for ``fb_scores`` (#352) -- the football game to show. 

312 fb_game: FbGame | None = None 

313 #: Set only for the football play scenes (``fb_play``, ``fb_playtext``, ``fb_event``, #377): 

314 #: the play, who was on it (jersey numbers), the event being celebrated or alerted, which 

315 #: stage of it this is (``football.director``), how many animation seconds in and how long 

316 #: the stage runs. ``fb_elapsed`` is not part of the scene's identity (it changes every 

317 #: frame; the live view would otherwise snapshot every one), and ``animating`` makes the 

318 #: loop run fast while the scene is up. 

319 fb_play: Play | None = None 

320 fb_people: tuple[Person, ...] = () 

321 fb_event: FbEvent | None = None 

322 fb_stage: str = "" 

323 #: Set only for the ``stats`` stage: the game's team stats (``football.stats.GameStats``). 

324 fb_stats: Any = None 

325 #: What an idle screen draws (#419): the view its builder in ``football/idle_screens.py`` made. 

326 fb_idle: Any = None 

327 #: Which page of a several-page idle screen (the standings' division, then conference). 

328 fb_page: int = 0 

329 fb_elapsed: float = field(default=0.0, compare=False) 

330 fb_seconds: float = 0.0 

331 animating: bool = False 

332 #: Set only for ``conference_leaders`` -- pixels the list has scrolled up. 

333 scroll_px: int = 0 

334 #: True while ``scroll_px`` is still moving, so the loop runs fast. 

335 scrolling: bool = False

338class ScoreboardApp: 

339 def __init__( 

340 self, 

341 settings: Settings, 

342 client: HockeyClient | None = None, 

343 backend: Backend | None = None, 

344 clock: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None, 

345 monotonic: Callable[[], float] | None = None, 

346 horn: GoalHornPlayer | None = None, 

347 light_sensor: LightSensor | None = None, 

348 admin_server: AdminServer | None = None, 

349 button: Button | None = None, 

350 sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None, 

351 ap_setup_state_path: Path | None = None, 

352 ap_scan_state_path: Path | None = None, 

353 ap_submission_state_path: Path | None = None, 

354 wifi_join: WifiJoinAttempt | None = None, 

355 hw_mapping_trial_path: Path | None = None, 

356 restart_service: Callable[[], None] | None = None, 

357 ip_lookup: Callable[[], str | None] | None = None, 

358 hostname_lookup: Callable[[], str] | None = None, 

359 alias_publisher: AliasPublisher | None = None, 

360 football_client_factory: Callable[[], Any] | None = None, 

361 fetcher: InlineFetcher | ThreadedFetcher | None = None, 

362 ) -> None: 

363 self.settings = settings 

364 #: Where hockey requests run (#267). Inline by default, so tests and the demo 

365 #: fetch and apply in one call; the real entry point passes a ThreadedFetcher 

366 #: so a slow API never stops the render loop. 

367 self.fetcher = fetcher or InlineFetcher() 

368 self._hostname_lookup = hostname_lookup or current_hostname 

369 #: None = never publish ``scoreboard.local`` (tests, the demo); the 

370 #: real entry point passes one (#292). 

371 self.alias_publisher = alias_publisher 

372 #: True while the admin page has stepped off port 80 so the WiFi setup 

373 #: page can have it (see _sync_setup_server). 

374 self._admin_yielded = False 

375 #: Injectable so tests never touch a real socket (#293). 

376 self._ip_lookup = ip_lookup or default_route_ip 

377 self._ip_cache: tuple[float, str | None] | None = None 

378 #: monotonic time the post-connect address screen runs until, and 

379 #: whether the last check found an address (see _track_address). 

380 self._address_until: float | None = None 

381 self._had_ip = False 

382 self._address_qr_cache: tuple[str, tuple[tuple[bool, ...], ...] | None] | None = None 

383 self.clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(UTC)) 

384 self.monotonic = monotonic or time.monotonic 

385 self.sleep = sleep or time.sleep 

386 self.ap_setup_state_path = ap_setup_state_path or AP_SETUP_STATE_PATH 

387 self.ap_scan_state_path = ap_scan_state_path or AP_SCAN_STATE_PATH 

388 self.ap_submission_state_path = ap_submission_state_path or AP_SUBMISSION_STATE_PATH 

389 #: The setup page's display check (#172) -- see HW_MAPPING_TRIAL_PATH. 

390 self.hw_mapping_trial_path = hw_mapping_trial_path or HW_MAPPING_TRIAL_PATH 

391 self._restart_service = restart_service or _restart_scoreboard_service 

392 #: Acts on a submission (#133): tears down the AP, calls 

393 #: scoreboard.wifi's shared join/rollback path, reports the 

394 #: outcome to the panel. A full object, not just a path, since 

395 #: tests need to substitute the whole thing (real subprocess/thread 

396 #: use), not just where its state files live. 

397 self.wifi_join = wifi_join or WifiJoinAttempt( 

398 config_path=settings.source_path or DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATHS[0], 

399 connect_timeout=settings.wifi.connect_timeout_seconds, 

400 submission_path=self.ap_submission_state_path, 

401 outcome_path=WIFI_JOIN_OUTCOME_PATH, 

402 ) 

403 #: The WiFi setup page (#132) -- only running while scoreboard- 

404 #: setup-ap's state file says the AP is up, kept in step by 

405 #: _sync_setup_server(). None means "not currently running", whether 

406 #: because the AP is down or wifi_setup.enabled is false. 

407 self.setup_server: SetupServer | None = None 

408 #: The (enabled, port) _sync_setup_server last built setup_server 

409 #: from, so a config reload's port change is noticed even if the AP 

410 #: state file's presence hasn't changed. None means no server wanted. 

411 self._setup_server_config: tuple[bool, int] | None = None 

412 #: (ssid, password) -> precomputed QR matrix, so a QR isn't 

413 #: recomputed every FRAME_INTERVAL for the whole time the AP stays 

414 #: up -- it only changes if the AP's own SSID/password ever would. 

415 self._ap_qr_cache: ( 

416 tuple[tuple[str, str | None], tuple[tuple[bool, ...], ...] | None] | None 

417 ) = None 

418 self.horn = horn or GoalHornPlayer.default( 

419 device=settings.audio.device, 

420 horn_dir=settings.audio.horn_dir, 

421 enabled=settings.audio.enabled, 

422 volume=settings.audio.volume, 

423 wah_wah=settings.audio.wah_wah, 

424 ding=settings.audio.ding, 

425 ) 

426 # Only probe the I2C bus when the feature is actually on -- a board 

427 # without the sensor shouldn't get I2C log noise every startup. 

428 if light_sensor is not None: 

429 self.light_sensor = light_sensor 

430 elif settings.panel.auto_brightness: 

431 self.light_sensor = LightSensor.open() 

432 else: 

433 self.light_sensor = None 

434 self._smoothed_lux: float | None = None 

435 # Same lazy-open rule as the light sensor: no GPIO claimed, and no 

436 # gpiozero import attempted, unless the button is actually enabled. 

437 if button is not None: 

438 self.button = button 

439 elif settings.button.enabled: 

440 self.button = Button.open( 

441 pin=settings.button.pin, hold_seconds=settings.button.hold_seconds 

442 ) 

443 else: 

444 self.button = None 

445 #: monotonic time the goal horn stays silent until, after a short 

446 #: button press (#50). None means not muted. 

447 self._horn_muted_until: float | None = None 

448 self._applied_brightness = settings.panel.brightness 

449 self.tz = resolve_timezone(settings.scoreboard.timezone) 

450 self._config_mtime = self._source_mtime() 

451 self.client = client or HockeyClient() 

452 self.backend = backend or load_backend() 

453 self.matrix, self.backend = create_matrix(settings.panel, self.backend) 

454 self.canvas = self.matrix.CreateFrameCanvas() 

455 #: The admin page's live view (#268): a snapshot per change of scene, 

456 #: only while it's open. _mirror_key is what the last one showed. 

457 self.mirror = Mirror(settings.panel.width, settings.panel.height) 

458 self._mirror_key: object = None 

459 logos = None 

460 if settings.scoreboard.show_logos: 

461 logos = LogoLibrary.default( 

462 size=min(settings.panel.height, 32), variant=settings.scoreboard.logo_variant 

463 ) 

464 graphics = MirrorGraphics(self.backend.graphics) 

465 self.renderer = Renderer( 

466 graphics=graphics, 

467 fonts=FontSet(graphics), 

468 width=settings.panel.width, 

469 height=settings.panel.height, 

470 tz=self.tz, 

471 logos=logos, 

472 ) 

473 self.renderer.football_logos = self._make_football_logos(settings) 

474 self.games: list[Game] = [] 

475 self.index = 0 

476 #: Fetch results waiting out ``broadcast_delay_seconds`` (#301), and the 

477 #: undelayed games the side fetches target so they start when the API 

478 #: says a game is live, not N seconds later. 

479 self._delay = DelayQueue(self.monotonic) 

480 self._latest_games: list[Game] | None = None 

481 self._shown_situations: dict[int, Situation | None] = {} 

482 self._shown_shootouts: dict[int, Shootout | None] = {} 

483 self.last_success: float | None = None 

484 #: Wall-clock companions to last_success, for the status page (#48) -- 

485 #: last_success itself is monotonic and not meaningful to a human. 

486 self.last_success_at: datetime | None = None 

487 self.last_error: str | None = None 

488 self.last_error_at: datetime | None = None 

489 #: When a later score poll succeeded after a score-poll error, so the 

490 #: admin page doesn't show a long-past blip as if it were current. 

491 self.last_error_recovered_at: datetime | None = None 

492 self._last_error_from_scores = False 

493 #: Only a server built here may be rebuilt to yield port 80. 

494 self._admin_owned = admin_server is None 

495 self.admin_server = admin_server if admin_server is not None else self._build_admin() 

496 #: game id -> (fetched at, situation). Only kept for the games we 

497 #: actually show the indicator on: the favourite's and the on-screen one. 

498 self.situations: dict[int, tuple[float, Situation | None]] = {} 

499 #: game id -> (fetched at, shootout, fetched after the game ended). 

500 #: Same targets as situations, but for games in a shootout (#259). 

501 self.shootouts: dict[int, tuple[float, Shootout | None, bool]] = {} 

502 #: game id -> {attempt sequence -> monotonic time it first showed up, 

503 #: None for attempts already there at our first sighting}, so a 

504 #: restart mid-shootout doesn't replay every cell (#259). 

505 self._shootout_seen: dict[int, dict[int, float | None]] = {} 

506 #: Whether the last shootout frame had a cell mid-animation, which 

507 #: speeds the loop up the way a moving holiday sprite does. 

508 self._shootout_animating = False 

509 self._scroll_animating = False 

510 #: Demo only: when the current step's newest attempt "appeared". 

511 self._demo_shootout_started: float | None = None 

512 #: Demo only: when the current step's goal light "started". 

513 self._demo_goal_started: float | None = None 

514 self._egg_animating = False 

515 #: ``scoreboard --eggs``: the tree egg being shown and its monotonic start (eggs.py). 

516 self._egg_show: tuple[str, float] | None = None 

517 #: The favourite's goal light is on screen (fast loop); _goal_building 

518 #: is its first BUILD_SECONDS, which a live-view snapshot waits out. 

519 self._goal_animating = False 

520 self._fb_animating = False 

521 self._goal_building = False 

522 #: The penalty screen is on (fast loop); _penalty_building is its 

523 #: entrance, which a live-view snapshot waits out (#340). 

524 self._penalty_animating = False 

525 self._penalty_building = False 

526 #: Demo only: when the current step's penalty screen "started". 

527 self._demo_penalty_started: float | None = None 

528 #: game id -> (fetched at), for the favourite's live games' penalty polls. 

529 self._penalty_fetched: dict[int, float] = {} 

530 #: game id -> keys of penalties already seen. Absent until the first 

531 #: fetch, which is a baseline that never fires (a restart mid-game 

532 #: doesn't replay) -- same precedent as goal detection. 

533 self._seen_penalties: dict[int, set[str]] = {} 

534 #: (game id, monotonic time, penalty) of the screen being shown. 

535 self._penalty: tuple[int, float, Penalty] | None = None 

536 #: game id -> when it ended (wall clock), for final_hold_minutes. Exact 

537 #: if we watched it finish; estimated from the start time otherwise. 

538 self.ended_at: dict[int, datetime] = {} 

539 self._seen_live: set[int] = set() 

540 self._schedule: tuple[float, list[Game]] | None = None 

541 #: monotonic time before which a failed schedule fetch won't retry -- 

542 #: without this, a schedule outage gets hit every select_scene() call 

543 #: (every FRAME_INTERVAL) instead of respecting SCHEDULE_TTL_SECONDS. 

544 self._schedule_retry_after: float = 0.0 

545 self._standings: tuple[float, list[StandingsRow]] | None = None 

546 #: same backoff as _schedule_retry_after, for standings failures. 

547 self._standings_retry_after: float = 0.0 

548 #: upcoming game id -> (fetched at, its head-to-head tally), for the 

549 #: opt-in matchup screen (#157). Only the current upcoming game's 

550 #: entry is ever kept; it's dropped once a different game is next. 

551 self._season_series: dict[int, tuple[float, SeasonSeriesRecord | None]] = {} 

552 #: upcoming game id -> retry-not-before, same backoff as 

553 #: _standings_retry_after but per game, so a new upcoming game isn't 

554 #: stuck behind the previous one's failure. 

555 self._season_series_retry_after: dict[int, float] = {} 

556 #: (team, fetched at, picked leaders) for the opt-in leaders screen (#201). 

557 #: The random tie-break is made once per fetch, so it holds for a whole 

558 #: TTL instead of flickering each frame. 

559 self._leaders: tuple[str, float, TeamLeaders | None] | None = None 

560 self._leaders_retry_after: float = 0.0 

561 #: Scopes the admin page's Cache tab asked to clear; applied on the render thread. 

562 self._cache_clears: set[str] = set() 

563 self._rng = random.Random() 

564 #: (game id, followed team) -> that team's own score last seen in that 

565 #: game, so a goal can be detected as an increase. Set on first 

566 #: sighting without firing, so a game already 3-1 at startup does not 

567 #: fire a goal. Keyed by team too: two followed teams can meet (#260). 

568 self._known_scores: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {} 

569 #: (game id, monotonic time, scoring team) of the most recent 

570 #: followed-team goal, for how long the goal scene stays up and 

571 #: whose colour and name it shows (#265). 

572 self.last_goal: tuple[int, float, str] | None = None 

573 #: game id -> (fetched at, followed teams' own GoalEvents seen so far 

574 #: in that game's scoring array). Followed teams only (#260), same 

575 #: scoping precedent as goal detection and the PP indicator (#122). 

576 self._goal_events: dict[int, tuple[float, tuple[GoalEvent, ...]]] = {} 

577 #: game id -> how many of the favourite's goal_events already had a 

578 #: goal_detail screen shown, so a late scorer/assist correction never 

579 #: re-fires for the same goal. Set to the full count on first 

580 #: sighting without firing, same precedent as _known_scores. 

581 self._shown_goal_events: dict[int, int] = {} 

582 #: (game id, monotonic time, event) of the most recent goal_detail 

583 #: screen, for how long it stays up. 

584 self._goal_detail: tuple[int, float, GoalEvent] | None = None 

585 #: team abbrev -> (fetched at, jersey number/points by player id), 

586 #: for GoalEvent's scorer_sweater_number/scorer_points (#124). Only 

587 #: ever fetched for a team that has actually just scored the 

588 #: favourite a goal-detail screen -- not proactively for every team 

589 #: in the schedule. 

590 self._team_rosters: dict[str, tuple[float, dict[int, PlayerSeasonDetail]]] = {} 

591 #: game id -> monotonic time of the last three-stars fetch attempt, 

592 #: for the favourite's games we watched go final and haven't got a 

593 #: non-empty threeStars for yet (#156). None = not tried yet. 

594 self._three_stars_pending: dict[int, float | None] = {} 

595 #: Game ids whose three-stars screen has already fired -- never again 

596 #: for the same game, independent of whether pending still has it. 

597 self._three_stars_shown: set[int] = set() 

598 #: (game id, monotonic time, stars) of the three-stars screen, for 

599 #: how long it stays up. 

600 self._three_stars: tuple[int, float, tuple[Star, ...]] | None = None 

601 #: game id -> (fetched at, its team stats) for the intermission screen, and when each 

602 #: game's fetch was last tried. Only the favourite's game in an intermission is fetched. 

603 self._int_stats: dict[int, tuple[float, GameStats]] = {} 

604 self._int_stats_tried: dict[int, float] = {} 

605 #: (game id, monotonic start) of the blowout flash (#326, blowout.py). 

606 self._blowout: tuple[int, float] | None = None 

607 self._blowout_shown: set[int] = set() 

608 #: The configured logo library, held by run_demo() while it toggles 

609 #: renderer.logos between it and None for the text layout. 

610 self._demo_real_logos: LogoLibrary | None = logos 

611 #: Live demo toggle (#204). Set from admin_server's thread, a plain 

612 #: bool read once per draw() on run()'s thread -- same cross-thread 

613 #: rule as the physical button's flags. Everything else the main 

614 #: loop does (polling, goal horn, config reload) keeps running. 

615 self._demo_mode = False 

616 self._demo_steps: list[DemoStep] = [] 

617 self._demo_step_index = 0 

618 self._demo_next_step_at = 0.0 

619 self._demo_scene: Scene | None = None 

620 self._demo_was_on = False 

621 #: Holiday decorations (#237). _overlay_animating is whether the 

622 #: last frame drew something moving, which is what speeds the loop 

623 #: up. While a demo is drawing, its own step decides the holiday 

624 #: (_demo_holiday) instead of the config and the calendar. 

625 self.holiday_overlay = HolidayOverlay() 

626 self._overlay_animating = False 

627 self._demo_drawing = False 

628 self._demo_holiday: Holiday | None = None 

629 self._running = False 

630 #: The sport the board is running right now (#346). Only 

631 #: ``_switch_sport`` changes it, so ``current_mode()`` is the one 

632 #: place that decides which sport's code runs. 

633 #: The ranked ``[[teams]]`` list (epic #470) picks it through the priority layer. 

634 self._sport = self._initial_sport(settings) 

635 self._football_client_factory = football_client_factory 

636 #: Football's mode exists whenever football may take the board (a football team is ranked, 

637 #: or nothing is and every live game counts): both feeds then run all the time and the 

638 #: priority layer picks between them. 

639 self._football: FootballMode | None = ( 

640 self._new_football() if self._wants("football", settings) else None 

641 ) 

642 #: Today's hockey games as the lite poll saw them while football has the screen (the full 

643 #: hockey machinery only runs for the sport on screen); the priority layer reads these. 

644 self._hockey_lite: list[Game] = [] 

645 #: When the light poll last succeeded (monotonic), so hockey is not stale on return. 

646 self._hockey_lite_at: float | None = None 

647 #: The priority layer's current owner (the favourite of the moment), set each loop. 

648 self._owner: Moment | None = None 

649 #: When the idle rotation began (monotonic): the sports alternate, and this puts the sport 

650 #: that has the turn at the top of its rotation. 

651 self._idle_origin = 0.0 

652 #: The rows of the idle segment now up, by sport (empty unless the sports alternate). 

653 self._segment_rows: dict[str, list[RotationEntry]] = {} 

654 self._priority_cache: tuple[tuple[TeamEntry, ...], Priority] | None = None 

655 #: The hockey favourite the caches were fetched for, to notice the owner changing it. 

656 self._hockey_favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

657 #: When the sport on screen last changed, for the minimum dwell between switches. 

658 self._sport_since = self.monotonic() 

659 #: Set by a sport switch so run() fetches on its next pass rather than 

660 #: leaving the new sport on ``connecting`` for a whole poll interval. 

661 self._poll_asap = False 

662 

663 # -- lifecycle ------------------------------------------------------- 

664 

665 def install_signal_handlers(self) -> None: 

666 for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM): 

667 signal.signal(sig, self._handle_signal) 

668 

669 def _handle_signal(self, signum: int, _frame: FrameType | None) -> None: 

670 log.info("Received signal %s; shutting down", signal.Signals(signum).name) 

671 self._running = False 

672 

673 def _apply_boot_volume(self) -> threading.Thread: 

674 """Push the configured volume to the mixer once, off the render loop. 

675 

676 apply_volume() blocks on `amixer`, so it runs on a short-lived daemon 

677 thread (#189). Without this a volume set only in the boot TOML was 

678 never applied until the admin page saved Audio or ran Test horn. 

679 """ 

680 

681 def work() -> None: 

682 try: 

683 self.horn.apply_volume() 

684 except Exception: 

685 log.exception("Could not apply boot volume") 

686 

687 thread = threading.Thread(target=work, name="apply-volume", daemon=True) 

688 thread.start() 

689 return thread 

690 

691 def run(self) -> None: 

692 self._running = True 

693 self._apply_boot_volume() 

694 if self.admin_server is not None: 

695 self.admin_server.start() 

696 self.renderer.draw_message(self.canvas, "HOCKEY", "CONNECTING") 

697 self.swap_canvas() 

698 if self._football is not None: 

699 self._football.start() 

700 

701 next_poll = 0.0 

702 next_rotate = 0.0 

703 next_brightness = 0.0 

704 while self._running: 

705 now = self.monotonic() 

706 self.reload_config_if_changed() 

707 self.handle_button() 

708 self._apply_cache_clears() 

709 self.fetcher.drain() 

710 if self._poll_asap: 

711 self._poll_asap = False 

712 next_poll = 0.0 

713 if now >= next_poll: 

714 self.refresh() 

715 next_poll = now + self.poll_interval() 

716 if now >= next_rotate: 

717 self.advance() 

718 next_rotate = now + self.settings.scoreboard.rotate_seconds 

719 if now >= next_brightness: 

720 self.refresh_brightness() 

721 next_brightness = now + self.settings.panel.brightness_poll_seconds 

722 if self.current_mode() == "hockey": 

723 self.refresh_situations() 

724 self.refresh_shootouts() 

725 self.refresh_goal_details() 

726 self.refresh_penalties() 

727 self.refresh_three_stars() 

728 self.refresh_intermission_stats() 

729 self._choose_sport() 

730 self._sync_setup_server() 

731 self._track_address() 

732 self._sync_alias() 

733 self.wifi_join.poll() 

734 self.wifi_join.expire_outcome_if_stale() 

735 self.draw() 

736 self.sleep(self.frame_interval()) 

737 self.shutdown() 

738 

739 def frame_interval(self) -> float: 

740 animating = ( 

741 self._overlay_animating 

742 or self._shootout_animating 

743 or self._scroll_animating 

744 or self._goal_animating 

745 or self._fb_animating 

746 or self._penalty_animating 

747 or self._egg_animating 

748 ) 

749 return ANIMATION_FRAME_INTERVAL if animating else FRAME_INTERVAL 

750 

751 def run_demo(self) -> None: 

752 """Loop every scene with synthetic data until stopped (#47). 

753 

754 Deliberately bypasses the real state machine: no ``refresh()``, 

755 ``select_scene()``, situation/brightness sampling or config reload, 

756 and no hockey client call at all -- coercing live data into every state 

757 on demand isn't possible, and a bench board may have no network. 

758 Goals drawn here never reach ``_on_goal()`` (only ``refresh()``'s 

759 ``_detect_goals()`` does), so the horn stays silent. 

760 """ 

761 self._running = True 

762 self._demo_real_logos = self.renderer.logos 

763 self._demo_drawing = True 

764 ticks_per_scene = max(1, round(DEMO_SCENE_SECONDS / FRAME_INTERVAL)) 

765 while self._running: 

766 # Rebuilt each pass so the preview/countdown stay relative to now. 

767 steps = self._demo_step_list() 

768 for step in steps: 

769 if not self._running: 

770 break 

771 self._set_demo_logos(step.use_logos) 

772 self._start_demo_holiday(step) 

773 self._start_demo_shootout(step) 

774 self._start_demo_goal(step) 

775 self._start_demo_penalty(step) 

776 if step.scroll_seconds: 

777 self._play_scrolling_demo_step(step.scene, step.scroll_seconds) 

778 continue 

779 if ( 

780 self._demo_holiday is not None 

781 or step.animate_shootout 

782 or step.animate_goal 

783 or step.animate_penalty 

784 ): 

785 self._play_animated_demo_step(step.scene) 

786 continue 

787 self.draw_scene(step.scene) 

788 for _ in range(ticks_per_scene): 

789 if not self._running: 

790 break 

791 self.sleep(FRAME_INTERVAL) 

792 self._demo_drawing = False 

793 self.renderer.logos = self._demo_real_logos 

794 self.shutdown() 

795 

796 def run_eggs(self, names: tuple[str, ...]) -> None: 

797 """Play the named Easter eggs in a loop until stopped (``--eggs``, see eggs.py). 

798 

799 Like ``run_demo`` it bypasses the state machine and hands scenes to ``draw_scene``. The 

800 clock is held on a date the screen's countdown works for, whatever the real date. 

801 """ 

802 from . import eggs 

803 

804 self._running = True 

805 self._demo_drawing = True 

806 real_clock = self.clock 

807 try: 

808 while self._running: 

809 for name in names: 

810 for phase in eggs.plan(name): 

811 self._play_egg_phase(phase, real_clock) 

812 finally: 

813 self._egg_show = None 

814 self.clock = real_clock 

815 self._demo_drawing = False 

816 self.shutdown() 

817 

818 def _play_egg_phase(self, phase: Any, real_clock: Any) -> None: 

819 """Draw one stretch of the egg tour (an ``eggs.Phase``), the clock held on its day.""" 

820 from . import eggs 

821 

822 month, day = phase.day or eggs.TOUR_DAY 

823 now = real_clock() 

824 offset = now.replace(month=month, day=day, hour=18) - now 

825 self.clock = lambda: real_clock() + offset 

826 started = self.monotonic() 

827 self._egg_show = (phase.egg, started) if phase.egg else None 

828 if phase.prank: 

829 # April Fools only happens on the day, on a Preds board: force it for this stretch. 

830 self.april_fools_active = lambda: True # type: ignore[method-assign] 

831 try: 

832 while self._running and self.monotonic() - started < phase.seconds: 

833 self.draw_scene(phase.scene) 

834 self.sleep(self.frame_interval()) 

835 finally: 

836 self._egg_show = None 

837 self.__dict__.pop("april_fools_active", None) 

838 

839 def _demo_step_list(self) -> list[DemoStep]: 

840 """The steps for the board's sport; football's are all text and field, no sound (#359).""" 

841 # Imported here: demo builds Scene objects, so a top-level import would be circular. 

842 if self._sport == "football": 

843 from .football.demo import football_demo_steps 

844 

845 return football_demo_steps(self.clock()) 

846 from .demo import demo_steps 

847 

848 # A demo has to show a favourite's screens: Nashville when no hockey team is ranked. 

849 return demo_steps(self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team or "NSH", self.clock()) 

850 

851 def _start_demo_holiday(self, step: DemoStep) -> None: 

852 """Force a step's holiday on, with a fly-by starting right now. 

853 

854 A demo step lasts seconds; the real gap between fly-bys is minutes. 

855 """ 

856 self._demo_holiday = HOLIDAYS.get(step.holiday) if step.holiday else None 

857 if self._demo_holiday is not None: 

858 self.holiday_overlay.start_flyby(self.monotonic()) 

859 

860 def _start_demo_shootout(self, step: DemoStep) -> None: 

861 """Make a step's newest shootout attempt pop in as the step starts (#259).""" 

862 self._demo_shootout_started = self.monotonic() if step.animate_shootout else None 

863 

864 def _start_demo_goal(self, step: DemoStep) -> None: 

865 """Start a step's goal light as the step starts.""" 

866 self._demo_goal_started = self.monotonic() if step.animate_goal else None 

867 

868 def _turkey_egg(self) -> tuple[str, float] | None: 

869 """The Thanksgiving turkey egg playing now and its age (#516); never in demo mode.""" 

870 if self._egg_show is not None: 

871 kind, started = self._egg_show 

872 return (kind, self.monotonic() - started) if kind == "turkey" else None 

873 if self._demo_drawing: 

874 return None 

875 return turkey_egg(self.clock().timestamp()) 

876 

877 def _tree_egg(self) -> tuple[str, float] | None: 

878 """The Christmas tree Easter egg playing now and its age (#509); never in demo mode.""" 

879 if self._egg_show is not None: 

880 kind, started = self._egg_show 

881 return (kind, self.monotonic() - started) if kind != "turkey" else None 

882 if self._demo_drawing: 

883 return None 

884 return tree_egg(self.clock().timestamp()) 

885 

886 def _start_demo_penalty(self, step: DemoStep) -> None: 

887 """Start a step's penalty screen as the step starts.""" 

888 self._demo_penalty_started = self.monotonic() if step.animate_penalty else None 

889 

890 def _penalty_age(self, scene: Scene) -> float | None: 

891 """Seconds into the penalty screen, or ``None`` for any other scene.""" 

892 if scene.kind != "penalty": 

893 return None 

894 if self._demo_penalty_started is not None: 

895 return self.monotonic() - self._demo_penalty_started 

896 if self._penalty is not None and scene.game is not None: 

897 game_id, started, _penalty = self._penalty 

898 if game_id == scene.game.id: 

899 return max(0.0, self.monotonic() - started) 

900 return 0.0 

901 

902 def _goal_age(self, scene: Scene) -> float | None: 

903 """Seconds into the favourite's goal light, or ``None`` for the quick 

904 static goal screen: followed teams' goals are quick updates (#260), 

905 and a goal scene with no goal behind it (a direct draw) has no age.""" 

906 if scene.kind != "goal": 

907 return None 

908 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

909 if april_fools.active(favourite, self.clock().astimezone(self.tz)): 

910 favourite = april_fools.PRANK_AS 

911 if not favourite or (scene.goal_team or favourite) != favourite: 

912 return None 

913 if self._demo_goal_started is not None: 

914 return self.monotonic() - self._demo_goal_started 

915 if self.last_goal is not None and scene.game is not None: 

916 game_id, goal_time, _team = self.last_goal 

917 if game_id == scene.game.id: 

918 return max(0.0, self.monotonic() - goal_time) 

919 return None 

920 

921 def _play_animated_demo_step(self, scene: Scene) -> None: 

922 """Redraw every frame for DEMO_SCENE_SECONDS, so the fly-by actually moves.""" 

923 end = self.monotonic() + DEMO_SCENE_SECONDS 

924 while self._running and self.monotonic() < end: 

925 self.draw_scene(scene) 

926 self.sleep(self.frame_interval()) 

927 

928 def _play_scrolling_demo_step(self, scene: Scene, seconds: float) -> None: 

929 """Scroll a conference table through one slot's worth of dwell.""" 

930 start = self.monotonic() 

931 while self._running and (elapsed := self.monotonic() - start) < seconds: 

932 self.draw_scene(self._scroll_conference(scene, elapsed, seconds)) 

933 self.sleep(self.frame_interval()) 

934 

935 def set_demo_mode(self, enabled: bool) -> None: 

936 """Turn the live demo on or off (#204); safe from any thread.""" 

937 self._demo_mode = bool(enabled) 

938 

939 def _draw_demo_step(self) -> None: 

940 """Advance the live demo on ``DEMO_SCENE_SECONDS`` and draw its current step.""" 

941 now = self.monotonic() 

942 if now >= self._demo_next_step_at: 

943 if self._demo_step_index >= len(self._demo_steps): 

944 # Rebuilt each pass so preview/countdown stay relative to now. 

945 self._demo_steps = self._demo_step_list() 

946 self._demo_step_index = 0 

947 step = self._demo_steps[self._demo_step_index] 

948 self._demo_step_index += 1 

949 self._demo_next_step_at = now + DEMO_SCENE_SECONDS 

950 self._set_demo_logos(step.use_logos) 

951 self._start_demo_holiday(step) 

952 self._start_demo_shootout(step) 

953 self._start_demo_goal(step) 

954 self._demo_scene = step.scene 

955 self._demo_drawing = True 

956 try: 

957 self.draw_scene(self._demo_scene) 

958 finally: 

959 self._demo_drawing = False 

960 

961 def _set_demo_logos(self, use_logos: bool) -> None: 

962 """Show the text fallback layout on demand, whatever the board has configured. 

963 

964 With ``show_logos`` off there was never a library, so logo steps 

965 simply draw as text too. 

966 """ 

967 self.renderer.logos = self._demo_real_logos if use_logos else None 

968 

969 def shutdown(self) -> None: 

970 try: 

971 if self._football is not None: 

972 self._football.stop() 

973 if self.admin_server is not None: 

974 self.admin_server.stop() 

975 if self.setup_server is not None: 

976 self.setup_server.stop() 

977 if self.alias_publisher is not None: 

978 self.alias_publisher.stop() 

979 if self.button is not None: 

980 self.button.close() 

981 self.matrix.Clear() 

982 finally: 

983 self.fetcher.close() 

984 self.client.close() 

985 log.info("Scoreboard stopped") 

986 

987 # -- data ------------------------------------------------------------ 

988 

989 @staticmethod 

990 def _make_football_logos(settings: Settings) -> LogoSet | None: 

991 """The football logo set, or ``None`` with logos switched off (#349). Cheap: the files 

992 are only read when a screen first asks for a team at a size.""" 

993 if not settings.scoreboard.show_logos: 

994 return None 

995 return LogoSet("football", settings.scoreboard.logo_variant) 

996 

997 def _new_football(self) -> FootballMode: 

998 """A football mode over the live settings. Its feed thread is not started here: ``run()`` 

999 starts it, and a later edit of the ranked list starts it once the loop is running.""" 

1000 return FootballMode( 

1001 lambda: self.settings.scoreboard, 

1002 client_factory=self._football_client_factory, 

1003 monotonic=self.monotonic, 

1004 football=self._football_cfg, 

1005 delay_seconds=self._delay_seconds, 

1006 utc_now=self.clock, 

1007 wide=lambda: self.renderer.width >= 128, 

1008 ) 

1009 

1010 def current_mode(self) -> str: 

1011 """``hockey`` or ``football``: the one place that says which sport is running (#346).""" 

1012 return self._sport 

1013 

1014 @staticmethod 

1015 def _initial_sport(settings: Settings) -> str: 

1016 """The sport to start on: the top-ranked team's, else hockey.""" 

1017 return settings.teams[0].sport if settings.teams else "hockey" 

1018 

1019 @staticmethod 

1020 def _wants(sport: str, settings: Settings) -> bool: 

1021 """Whether ``sport``'s feed is needed: a team of it is ranked, or none is (every live game 

1022 of either sport counts then). A hockey-only list never polls football's feed.""" 

1023 return not settings.teams or any(entry.sport == sport for entry in settings.teams) 

1024 

1025 def _reset_favourite_caches(self) -> None: 

1026 """Forget what was fetched for the previous favourite. 

1027 

1028 ``next_favourite_game()``'s ``_schedule`` cache is one season schedule for whichever team 

1029 it was last fetched for, kept fresh purely by ``SCHEDULE_TTL_SECONDS`` elapsing: nothing in 

1030 that check knows *which* team the cached games belong to. Left alone, a change of 

1031 favourite keeps showing the *previous* team's next game (a different matchup entirely) for 

1032 up to an hour, which is exactly why the matchup screen (#157) once kept showing the old 

1033 opponent. Only the countdown/preview/matchup fallback to the season schedule is affected 

1034 (today's game is read fresh from ``self.games``). The team leaders are one team's too. 

1035 

1036 Called when the ranked list is edited and when the owner (the favourite of the moment) 

1037 changes.""" 

1038 self._schedule = None 

1039 self._schedule_retry_after = 0.0 

1040 self._leaders = None 

1041 self._leaders_retry_after = 0.0 

1042 

1043 def _colour_scheme(self, favourite: str, *, clock: bool = False) -> tuple[str, str]: 

1044 """The (sport, team) the clock, tree and holiday overlay take their colours from. 

1045 

1046 It is the overall rank 1, whichever sport is on screen, so the colours do not change as 

1047 games start and end (epic #470). With no team ranked they are plain, as the clock always was 

1048 in football mode (``favourite`` is only what a game screen is about, not a colour choice). 

1049 """ 

1050 if favourite == april_fools.PRANK_AS: 

1051 return "hockey", favourite # the April Fools prank recolours everything, as ever 

1052 first = self._priority().colour_team() 

1053 if first is not None: 

1054 return first.sport, first.team 

1055 return "hockey", "" 

1056 

1057 def _priority(self) -> Priority: 

1058 """The priority layer over the current ranked list (rebuilt only when the list changes).""" 

1059 teams = tuple(self.settings.teams) 

1060 if self._priority_cache is None or self._priority_cache[0] != teams: 

1061 self._priority_cache = (teams, Priority(teams)) 

1062 return self._priority_cache[1] 

1063 

1064 def _football_cfg(self) -> Any: 

1065 """Football's settings as its screens read them: ``[football]`` seen through 

1066 the priority layer (the owner is the favourite, the other ranked football teams are 

1067 followed, the lead team has the horn; with no team ranked, nobody is).""" 

1068 return self._priority().view( 

1069 "football", self.settings.football, self._owner, self._sport_rotation("football") 

1070 ) 

1071 

1072 def _hockey_cfg(self) -> Any: 

1073 """Hockey's settings as its screens read them: ``[scoreboard]`` seen through 

1074 the priority layer (the owner is the favourite, the other ranked hockey teams are followed, 

1075 the lead team has the horn; with no team ranked, nobody is).""" 

1076 return self._priority().view("hockey", self.settings.scoreboard, self._owner) 

1077 

1078 def _priority_windows(self) -> dict[str, Windows]: 

1079 hockey, football = self.settings.scoreboard, self.settings.football 

1080 return { 

1081 "hockey": Windows( 

1082 countdown=timedelta(hours=hockey.countdown_hours), 

1083 final_hold=timedelta(minutes=hockey.final_hold_minutes), 

1084 ), 

1085 "football": Windows( 

1086 countdown=timedelta(minutes=football.countdown_minutes), 

1087 final_hold=timedelta(minutes=football.final_hold_minutes), 

1088 ), 

1089 } 

1090 

1091 def _desired_sport(self) -> str: 

1092 """The sport the ranked list wants on screen now (epic #470). 

1093 

1094 The owner (the highest-ranked team that is live, else in its countdown, else in a held 

1095 final) decides; with nobody on, the sports take turns showing their idle rotations. With no 

1096 team ranked at all, a live game of either sport takes the board (hockey first), and 

1097 otherwise hockey keeps it (its no-favourite flow shows every game, or the clock). 

1098 """ 

1099 football_games = list(self._football.snapshot.games or ()) if self._football else [] 

1100 hockey_games = self._hockey_priority_games() 

1101 now = self.clock() 

1102 ages = {("hockey", gid): now - ended for gid, ended in self.ended_at.items()} 

1103 if self._football is not None: 

1104 self._football.track() 

1105 ages.update( 

1106 { 

1107 ("football", gid): timedelta(seconds=s) 

1108 for gid, s in self._football.final_ages().items() 

1109 } 

1110 ) 

1111 priority = self._priority() 

1112 owner = priority.owner( 

1113 {"hockey": hockey_games, "football": football_games}, 

1114 now, 

1115 self._priority_windows(), 

1116 ages, 

1117 ) 

1118 self._owner = owner 

1119 if owner is not None: 

1120 self._segment_rows = {} 

1121 return owner.sport 

1122 if priority.empty: 

1123 self._idle_origin = 0.0 

1124 games = {"hockey": hockey_games, "football": football_games} 

1125 return priority.empty_list_sport(games) or "hockey" 

1126 return self._idle_sport(priority) 

1127 

1128 def _hockey_priority_games(self) -> list[Game]: 

1129 """Today's hockey games for the priority layer: the full machinery's while hockey has the 

1130 board, else the light poll's. Right after a switch to hockey ``games`` is still empty until 

1131 the next poll, so the light poll's last answer covers that gap.""" 

1132 return (self.games if self._sport == "hockey" else None) or self._hockey_lite 

1133 

1134 def _idle_available(self) -> list[str]: 

1135 """The sports with something to show now, best-ranked lead first: a sport whose slate is 

1136 empty (the offseason, or its feed is down) sits out of the idle rotation.""" 

1137 football_games = self._football.snapshot.games if self._football is not None else None 

1138 have = {"hockey": bool(self._hockey_priority_games()), "football": bool(football_games)} 

1139 order = self._priority().sports() or ["hockey", "football"] 

1140 return [sport for sport in order if have.get(sport)] 

1141 

1142 def _idle_sport(self, priority: Priority) -> str: 

1143 """With nothing ranked on, the one idle rotation runs across both sports: its rows are 

1144 grouped into per-sport segments and the board alternates between them (epic #470). Falls 

1145 back to the top-ranked team's sport when no sport has anything to show.""" 

1146 segments = idle_segments(self._unified_rotation(), self._idle_available()) 

1147 now = self.monotonic() 

1148 slot = segment_at(segments, now) 

1149 self._segment_rows = {} 

1150 if slot is None: 

1151 self._idle_origin = 0.0 

1152 if self._football is not None: 

1153 self._football.idle_origin = 0.0 

1154 return priority.sports()[0] 

1155 index, fraction = slot 

1156 segment = segments[index] 

1157 # The segment began ``fraction`` of its length ago: its sport times its rows from there. 

1158 self._idle_origin = now - fraction * segment.seconds 

1159 self._segment_rows = {segment.sport: list(segment.entries)} 

1160 if self._football is not None: 

1161 self._football.idle_origin = self._idle_origin 

1162 return segment.sport 

1163 

1164 def _apply_teams_change(self, new_settings: Settings) -> None: 

1165 """The ranked list was edited: start or stop football's feed as it is wanted, forget what 

1166 belonged to the old favourite and followed teams, and let the next ``_choose_sport`` pick 

1167 from the new order.""" 

1168 wants_football = self._wants("football", new_settings) 

1169 if wants_football and self._football is None: 

1170 self._football = self._new_football() 

1171 if wants_football and self._running: 

1172 self._football.start() # idempotent 

1173 elif not wants_football and self._football is not None: 

1174 self._football.stop() # its feed thread must not outlive the mode 

1175 self._football = None 

1176 if self._sport == "football": 

1177 self._switch_sport("hockey", force_clean=True) 

1178 self._reset_favourite_caches() 

1179 # _goal_events counts only followed teams' goals, so a team added mid-game would read as its 

1180 # whole tally scoring at once. Forget them; the next poll re-baselines without firing. 

1181 self._goal_events.clear() 

1182 self._shown_goal_events.clear() 

1183 self._seen_penalties.clear() 

1184 self._penalty_fetched.clear() 

1185 self._choose_sport(force=True) # an edit takes effect now, not after the minimum dwell 

1186 

1187 def _choose_sport(self, *, force: bool = False) -> None: 

1188 """Switch the sport on screen when the ranked list wants another, but not twice within 

1189 ``SPORT_MIN_DWELL_SECONDS``: a game starting is taken at once after a quiet spell, yet two 

1190 borderline moments cannot make the board flip back and forth.""" 

1191 wanted = self._desired_sport() 

1192 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

1193 if favourite != self._hockey_favourite: 

1194 self._hockey_favourite = favourite 

1195 self._reset_favourite_caches() 

1196 dwelt = self.monotonic() - self._sport_since >= SPORT_MIN_DWELL_SECONDS 

1197 if wanted != self._sport and (force or dwelt): 

1198 # An edit of the list (``force``) starts the new sport from a clean slate; only the idle 

1199 # rotation's own alternation keeps hockey's state. 

1200 self._switch_sport(wanted, force_clean=force) 

1201 

1202 def _switch_sport(self, sport: str, *, force_clean: bool = False) -> None: 

1203 """Swap the running sport live, from a clean slate (#346). 

1204 

1205 Drops everything the old sport held -- cached data, remembered scores, 

1206 goal detection, the last scene, animations -- so the new sport starts 

1207 at ``connecting`` and baselines on its first fetch: nothing celebrates 

1208 or sounds on the first frame after a switch. The button mute is the 

1209 owner's, not the sport's, so it survives. 

1210 """ 

1211 # The idle rotation passing between the sports happens every few seconds and says nothing 

1212 # new, so it is DEBUG; a switch caused by a game, or by editing the list, stays INFO. 

1213 idle_alternation = self._owner is None and not force_clean 

1214 log.log( 

1215 logging.DEBUG if idle_alternation else logging.INFO, 

1216 "Switching sport %s -> %s", 

1217 self._sport, 

1218 sport, 

1219 ) 

1220 if self._sport == "hockey" and self.games: 

1221 self._hockey_lite = list(self.games) # the priority layer keeps seeing hockey's slate 

1222 self._hockey_lite_at = self.last_success 

1223 # Both feeds keep running: football's mode stays up and only starts its screens afresh when 

1224 # it takes the board. 

1225 if self._football is None: 

1226 # Normally only when a football team is ranked (or none is); a demo on a hockey-only 

1227 # board asks for football explicitly, and football's mode must exist to show it. 

1228 if sport == "football" or self._wants("football", self.settings): 

1229 self._football = self._new_football() 

1230 if self._running: 

1231 self._football.start() 

1232 elif sport == "football": 

1233 self._football.reset_screens() 

1234 self._sport = sport 

1235 self._sport_since = self.monotonic() 

1236 self._poll_asap = True 

1237 if self._owner is None and not force_clean: 

1238 # Nothing ranked is on, so this is only the idle rotation passing between the sports, 

1239 # which happens every few seconds. Wiping hockey's state each time put CONNECTING on 

1240 # the panel at every return and emptied its standings, schedule and leaders caches. 

1241 # Keep it all; hockey comes back on its light poll's last answer, and the next poll 

1242 # catches up. Scores are re-baselined so a goal scored while away does not celebrate. 

1243 if sport == "hockey": 

1244 if self._hockey_lite: 

1245 self.games = list(self._hockey_lite) 

1246 self.last_success = self._hockey_lite_at or self.last_success 

1247 self._known_scores = {} 

1248 self._mirror_key = None 

1249 self.mirror.requested = True 

1250 return 

1251 self.games = [] 

1252 self.index = 0 

1253 self._delay = DelayQueue(self.monotonic) 

1254 self._latest_games = None 

1255 self._shown_situations = {} 

1256 self._shown_shootouts = {} 

1257 self.situations = {} 

1258 self.shootouts = {} 

1259 self._shootout_seen = {} 

1260 self.last_success = None 

1261 self.last_success_at = None 

1262 self.last_error = None 

1263 self.last_error_at = None 

1264 self.last_error_recovered_at = None 

1265 self._last_error_from_scores = False 

1266 self.ended_at = {} 

1267 self._seen_live = set() 

1268 self._schedule = None 

1269 self._schedule_retry_after = 0.0 

1270 self._standings = None 

1271 self._standings_retry_after = 0.0 

1272 self._season_series = {} 

1273 self._season_series_retry_after = {} 

1274 self._leaders = None 

1275 self._leaders_retry_after = 0.0 

1276 self._known_scores = {} 

1277 self.last_goal = None 

1278 self._goal_events = {} 

1279 self._shown_goal_events = {} 

1280 self._goal_detail = None 

1281 self._team_rosters = {} 

1282 self._three_stars_pending = {} 

1283 self._three_stars_shown = set() 

1284 self._three_stars = None 

1285 self._int_stats = {} 

1286 self._int_stats_tried = {} 

1287 self._blowout = None 

1288 self._blowout_shown = set() 

1289 self._shootout_animating = False 

1290 self._scroll_animating = False 

1291 self._goal_animating = self._goal_building = self._fb_animating = False 

1292 self._overlay_animating = False 

1293 self._demo_shootout_started = None 

1294 self._demo_goal_started = None 

1295 self._egg_animating = False 

1296 self._mirror_key = None 

1297 self.mirror.requested = True 

1298 

1299 def refresh(self) -> None: 

1300 if self._sport == "football" and self._football is not None: 

1301 self._football.refresh() 

1302 if self._wants("hockey", self.settings): 

1303 # Hockey keeps being polled, lightly, so the priority layer can see it start. 

1304 self.fetcher.submit("scores_lite", self.client.scores, self._on_scores_lite) 

1305 return 

1306 self.fetcher.submit("scores", self.client.scores, self._on_scores) 

1307 

1308 def _on_scores_lite(self, games: list[Game] | None, error: Exception | None) -> None: 

1309 """The hockey poll made while football has the screen: remember the games for the priority 

1310 layer and nothing else (no goal detection, no horn, no status errors).""" 

1311 if error is not None or games is None: 

1312 log.debug("Hockey lite poll failed: %s", error) 

1313 return 

1314 self._hockey_lite = list(games) 

1315 self._hockey_lite_at = self.monotonic() 

1316 

1317 def _on_scores(self, games: list[Game] | None, error: Exception | None) -> None: 

1318 """A score fetch finished (on the render thread): apply it, or record the failure.""" 

1319 if error is not None or games is None: 

1320 log.warning("Score refresh failed: %s", error) 

1321 self._record_error(f"score refresh: {error}", from_scores=True) 

1322 return 

1323 self._latest_games = self.order(games) 

1324 self.last_success = self.monotonic() 

1325 self.last_success_at = self.clock() 

1326 if self._last_error_from_scores and self.last_error_recovered_at is None: 

1327 self.last_error_recovered_at = self.last_success_at 

1328 self._submit("games", lambda: self._apply_games(games)) 

1329 

1330 def _delay_seconds(self) -> float: 

1331 return min(max(self.settings.scoreboard.broadcast_delay_seconds, 0.0), 300.0) 

1332 

1333 def _submit(self, key: object, apply: Callable[[], None]) -> None: 

1334 """Apply a fetch result after the broadcast delay (#301); at once with none.""" 

1335 self._delay.submit(key, self._delay_seconds(), apply) 

1336 

1337 def _api_games(self) -> list[Game]: 

1338 """Today's games as the API has them now, ahead of the delayed ``self.games``. 

1339 

1340 Side fetches (situation, shootout, scorer) and the poll cadence follow 

1341 this so they start on time; their results are delayed on the way in. 

1342 """ 

1343 if self._latest_games is not None and self._delay_seconds() > 0: 

1344 return self._latest_games 

1345 return self.games 

1346 

1347 def _apply_games(self, games: list[Game]) -> None: 

1348 self.games = self.order(games) 

1349 self._detect_goals(self.games) 

1350 now = self.clock() 

1351 for game in self.games: 

1352 if game.is_live: 

1353 self._seen_live.add(game.id) 

1354 elif game.is_final and game.id not in self.ended_at: 

1355 # Watched it finish: now is the end. Found it already over 

1356 # (typically at startup): the API has no end time, so 

1357 # estimate one rather than holding a stale final for the 

1358 # full window from whenever we happened to start. 

1359 watched = game.id in self._seen_live 

1360 self.ended_at[game.id] = now if watched else min(now, game.estimated_end()) 

1361 self._queue_three_stars(game, watched=watched) 

1362 self._note_blowout(game, watched=watched) 

1363 log.debug( 

1364 "Game %s ended at %s (%s)", 

1365 game.id, 

1366 self.ended_at[game.id], 

1367 "observed" if watched else "estimated", 

1368 ) 

1369 self._prune_game_state() 

1370 if self.index >= len(self.games): 

1371 self.index = 0 

1372 log.debug("Refreshed: %d games", len(self.games)) 

1373 

1374 def _prune_game_state(self) -> None: 

1375 """Drop bookkeeping for games no longer in today's slate. 

1376 

1377 ``_seen_live``, ``ended_at``, ``_known_scores`` and the 

1378 goal-detail/three-stars bookkeeping are keyed by game id and 

1379 otherwise never cleared, growing by one entry per game for as long 

1380 as the process runs (#64). ``self.games`` is 

1381 refreshed from the live schedule every poll, so any id no longer in 

1382 it is done for today and safe to forget. 

1383 """ 

1384 current_ids = {game.id for game in self.games} | {game.id for game in self._api_games()} 

1385 self._delay.forget(lambda key: not isinstance(key, tuple) or key[1] in current_ids) 

1386 for shown in (self._shown_situations, self._shown_shootouts): 

1387 for game_id in list(shown): 

1388 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1389 del shown[game_id] 

1390 self._seen_live &= current_ids 

1391 for game_id in list(self.ended_at): 

1392 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1393 del self.ended_at[game_id] 

1394 for key in list(self._known_scores): 

1395 if key[0] not in current_ids: 

1396 del self._known_scores[key] 

1397 for game_id in list(self._goal_events): 

1398 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1399 del self._goal_events[game_id] 

1400 for game_id in list(self._shown_goal_events): 

1401 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1402 del self._shown_goal_events[game_id] 

1403 for game_id in list(self._three_stars_pending): 

1404 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1405 del self._three_stars_pending[game_id] 

1406 for game_id in list(self._seen_penalties): 

1407 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1408 del self._seen_penalties[game_id] 

1409 for game_id in list(self._penalty_fetched): 

1410 if game_id not in current_ids: 

1411 del self._penalty_fetched[game_id] 

1412 self._three_stars_shown &= current_ids 

1413 self._blowout_shown &= current_ids 

1414 

1415 def _record_error(self, message: str, *, from_scores: bool = False) -> None: 

1416 """Track the most recent fetch failure, for the status page (#48). 

1417 

1418 Only a score-poll error can be marked recovered: the next good score 

1419 poll says nothing about whether, say, the standings fetch works now. 

1420 """ 

1421 self.last_error = message 

1422 self.last_error_at = self.clock() 

1423 self.last_error_recovered_at = None 

1424 self._last_error_from_scores = from_scores 

1425 

1426 # -- config reload (#51) ---------------------------------------------- 

1427 

1428 def _source_mtime(self) -> float | None: 

1429 path = self.settings.source_path 

1430 if path is None: 

1431 return None 

1432 try: 

1433 return path.stat().st_mtime 

1434 except OSError: 

1435 return None 

1436 

1437 def reload_config_if_changed(self) -> bool: 

1438 """Reload scoreboard.toml in place if it changed on disk since last checked. 

1439 

1440 Polls mtime rather than reacting to a signal from any particular 

1441 editor: the file is documented to be editable by any method -- SD 

1442 card on another machine, ``nano`` over SSH, or the eventual web 

1443 editor (#48) -- and all three need to pick up a change the same way. 

1444 Most settings are already read fresh from ``self.settings`` every 

1445 loop iteration; ``[audio]``, the logo library, the ambient light 

1446 sensor (``panel.auto_brightness``), the admin server 

1447 (``status.enabled``/``status.port``) and the physical button 

1448 (``[button]``, #50) are built once from it instead, so those get 

1449 rebuilt explicitly here (#62). A rebuilt admin server 

1450 is only started if ``run()``'s loop is live (``self._running``): 

1451 ``run()`` starts it exactly once before looping, so a reload outside 

1452 that loop -- e.g. a test calling this directly -- builds it without 

1453 binding a socket, just as ``__init__`` does. ``[panel]`` geometry 

1454 (rows/cols/chain_length/hardware_mapping/...) is baked into the 

1455 already-constructed ``RGBMatrix`` and deliberately NOT reloaded -- 

1456 that needs a process restart. 

1457 """ 

1458 mtime = self._source_mtime() 

1459 if mtime is None or mtime == self._config_mtime: 

1460 return False 

1461 self._config_mtime = mtime 

1462 try: 

1463 new_settings = Settings.from_toml(self.settings.source_path) 

1464 except (OSError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError) as exc: 

1465 log.warning("Config reload failed, keeping previous settings: %s", exc) 

1466 return False 

1467 self._apply_reloaded_settings(new_settings) 

1468 log.info("Reloaded configuration from %s", new_settings.source_path) 

1469 return True 

1470 

1471 def _apply_reloaded_settings(self, new_settings: Settings) -> None: 

1472 """Apply a config reload's side effects, field by field. 

1473 

1474 Deliberately explicit/per-field rather than one generic "something 

1475 changed, re-fetch and rebuild everything" pass -- consistent with 

1476 this project's usual anti-premature-abstraction stance, and a 

1477 blanket invalidation would force unrelated work on every save 

1478 (e.g. a schedule refetch or horn rebuild triggered by editing 

1479 goal_flash_seconds). The real risk with this approach isn't that 

1480 it doesn't scale, it's that a *new* piece of state cached off a 

1481 setting (self._schedule/_standings/_season_series-shaped, or a 

1482 rebuilt object like self.horn/renderer.logos) can be added without 

1483 anyone remembering to hook its invalidation in here -- exactly how 

1484 the favourite's _schedule fix (``_reset_favourite_caches``) was missing until a 

1485 live bug (#178's admin-page work) surfaced it. When adding a new 

1486 cache or rebuilt-from-settings object anywhere in this class, 

1487 check here first: does a relevant field change need to reset or 

1488 rebuild it, the same way audio_changed/logos_changed/ 

1489 teams_changed/etc. do below? 

1490 """ 

1491 old = self.settings 

1492 audio_changed = dataclasses.astuple(old.audio) != dataclasses.astuple(new_settings.audio) 

1493 logos_changed = ( 

1494 old.scoreboard.show_logos != new_settings.scoreboard.show_logos 

1495 or old.scoreboard.logo_variant != new_settings.scoreboard.logo_variant 

1496 ) 

1497 timezone_changed = old.scoreboard.timezone != new_settings.scoreboard.timezone 

1498 teams_changed = old.teams != new_settings.teams 

1499 auto_brightness_changed = old.panel.auto_brightness != new_settings.panel.auto_brightness 

1500 status_changed = ( 

1501 old.status.enabled, 

1502 old.status.port, 

1503 old.status.alias_port, 

1504 ) != (new_settings.status.enabled, new_settings.status.port, new_settings.status.alias_port) 

1505 # mute_minutes is read fresh on every press, so it alone needs no rebuild. 

1506 button_changed = (old.button.enabled, old.button.pin, old.button.hold_seconds) != ( 

1507 new_settings.button.enabled, 

1508 new_settings.button.pin, 

1509 new_settings.button.hold_seconds, 

1510 ) 

1511 

1512 self.settings = new_settings 

1513 

1514 if teams_changed: 

1515 # The favourite's cached season schedule and team leaders belong to one team, and the 

1516 # followed teams' goal tallies to the old set (see ``_reset_favourite_caches``). 

1517 self._apply_teams_change(new_settings) 

1518 

1519 if timezone_changed: 

1520 self.tz = resolve_timezone(new_settings.scoreboard.timezone, fallback=self.tz) 

1521 self.renderer.tz = self.tz 

1522 

1523 if audio_changed: 

1524 # volume is carried on the rebuilt object but deliberately not 

1525 # applied to the ALSA mixer here: GoalHornPlayer.apply_volume() 

1526 # blocks on a real `amixer` subprocess, and this method runs on 

1527 # the same thread as frame rendering -- a stalled/slow amixer 

1528 # call here would stutter the panel. admin_server.py applies it 

1529 # instead, from its own background thread, on an audio save and 

1530 # on Test horn (#187). 

1531 self.horn = GoalHornPlayer.default( 

1532 device=new_settings.audio.device, 

1533 horn_dir=new_settings.audio.horn_dir, 

1534 enabled=new_settings.audio.enabled, 

1535 volume=new_settings.audio.volume, 

1536 wah_wah=new_settings.audio.wah_wah, 

1537 ding=new_settings.audio.ding, 

1538 ) 

1539 

1540 if logos_changed: 

1541 logos = None 

1542 if new_settings.scoreboard.show_logos: 

1543 logos = LogoLibrary.default( 

1544 size=min(new_settings.panel.height, 32), 

1545 variant=new_settings.scoreboard.logo_variant, 

1546 ) 

1547 self.renderer.logos = logos 

1548 self.renderer.football_logos = self._make_football_logos(new_settings) 

1549 

1550 if auto_brightness_changed: 

1551 # Same lazy probe as __init__: only touch the I2C bus when the 

1552 # feature is on. Turning it off just drops the sensor, which is 

1553 # what refresh_brightness() already treats as "feature off". 

1554 self.light_sensor = LightSensor.open() if new_settings.panel.auto_brightness else None 

1555 

1556 if status_changed: 

1557 # AdminServer's port is fixed at construction, so any change 

1558 # means stop-and-rebuild rather than reconfigure in place. 

1559 if self.admin_server is not None: 

1560 self.admin_server.stop() 

1561 self.admin_server = self._build_admin() 

1562 # run() starts the server once, before its loop; a rebuild 

1563 # inside the loop has to start itself. Outside the loop, 

1564 # construct only -- same as __init__ -- so it's run() that 

1565 # binds the socket, not whoever happened to reload. 

1566 if self.admin_server is not None and self._running: 

1567 self.admin_server.start() 

1568 

1569 if button_changed: 

1570 # gpiozero fixes pin and hold_time at construction; close first 

1571 # so the rebuilt one can reclaim the same pin. 

1572 if self.button is not None: 

1573 self.button.close() 

1574 self.button = ( 

1575 Button.open( 

1576 pin=new_settings.button.pin, hold_seconds=new_settings.button.hold_seconds 

1577 ) 

1578 if new_settings.button.enabled 

1579 else None 

1580 ) 

1581 

1582 # wifi.connect_timeout_seconds: plain attribute update, no 

1583 # stop/rebuild needed the way AdminServer's fixed-at-construction 

1584 # port does -- WifiJoinAttempt reads it fresh on its next attempt, 

1585 # and there's nothing live to restart if one isn't in progress. 

1586 self.wifi_join.connect_timeout = new_settings.wifi.connect_timeout_seconds 

1587 

1588 # -- auto brightness --------------------------------------------------- 

1589 

1590 def refresh_brightness(self) -> None: 

1591 """Re-apply matrix brightness: night mode, else the ambient sensor, else static. 

1592 

1593 Night mode (#92) wins over the ambient sensor while it's actively 

1594 dimming -- a scheduled window must dim even with the lights on, and 

1595 is already held off during a live game, which a lux sensor in a 

1596 dark TV room can't know about. Outside it, the sensor (if any) 

1597 drives brightness exactly as before; with no sensor the static 

1598 ``brightness`` is re-applied, which is what brings the panel back 

1599 up once a night window ends. A sensor that isn't answering leaves 

1600 brightness where it is. 

1601 """ 

1602 if self._night_mode_active(): 

1603 self._apply_brightness(self.settings.night_mode.dim_brightness) 

1604 return 

1605 if self.light_sensor is None: 

1606 self._apply_brightness(self.settings.panel.brightness) 

1607 return 

1608 lux = self.light_sensor.read_lux() 

1609 if lux is None: 

1610 return 

1611 self._smoothed_lux = ( 

1612 lux 

1613 if self._smoothed_lux is None 

1614 else self._smoothed_lux + BRIGHTNESS_SMOOTHING * (lux - self._smoothed_lux) 

1615 ) 

1616 panel = self.settings.panel 

1617 target = lux_to_brightness(self._smoothed_lux, panel.min_brightness, panel.max_brightness) 

1618 self._apply_brightness(target) 

1619 

1620 def _apply_brightness(self, target: int) -> None: 

1621 if target == self._applied_brightness: 

1622 return 

1623 self._applied_brightness = target 

1624 try: 

1625 self.matrix.brightness = target 

1626 except (AttributeError, TypeError): 

1627 # The emulator and real rgbmatrix binding both expose a live 

1628 # settable brightness; a backend that doesn't just keeps 

1629 # whatever it was constructed with. 

1630 log.debug("Backend %s has no settable brightness", self.backend.name) 

1631 

1632 # -- night mode (#92) ------------------------------------------------ 

1633 

1634 def _in_night_window(self) -> bool: 

1635 cfg = self.settings.night_mode 

1636 now = self.clock().astimezone(self.tz).time() 

1637 if cfg.start <= cfg.end: 

1638 return cfg.start <= now < cfg.end 

1639 return now >= cfg.start or now < cfg.end 

1640 

1641 def _night_mode_suppressed(self) -> bool: 

1642 """A relevant game is live, or finished less than cooldown_minutes ago. 

1643 

1644 "tracked" means every followed team's games (#260), the favourite's 

1645 included. With no team followed at all it has nothing to track, so 

1646 it behaves as "all" -- a normal combination (no favourite_team 

1647 configured, with night mode on), not a misconfiguration worth a 

1648 warning. 

1649 """ 

1650 cfg = self.settings.night_mode 

1651 if cfg.suppress_scope == "all" or not self._hockey_cfg().followed_teams: 

1652 candidates = self.games 

1653 else: 

1654 candidates = [g for g in self.games if self._is_followed(g)] 

1655 if any(g.is_live for g in candidates): 

1656 return True 

1657 ended = [self.ended_at[g.id] for g in candidates if g.id in self.ended_at] 

1658 if not ended: 

1659 return False 

1660 return self.clock() - max(ended) < timedelta(minutes=cfg.cooldown_minutes) 

1661 

1662 def _night_mode_active(self) -> bool: 

1663 """Should the panel be at night_mode.dim_brightness right now?""" 

1664 return ( 

1665 self.settings.night_mode.enabled 

1666 and self._in_night_window() 

1667 and not self._night_mode_suppressed() 

1668 ) 

1669 

1670 # -- goal detection --------------------------------------------------- 

1671 

1672 def _is_followed(self, game: Game) -> bool: 

1673 """Does ``game`` involve the favourite or an ``also_follow`` team (#260)?""" 

1674 return any(game.involves(team) for team in self._hockey_cfg().followed_teams) 

1675 

1676 def _celebrated_teams(self, game: Game) -> list[str]: 

1677 """The teams in ``game`` whose goals get the goal screen (#260). 

1678 

1679 In the favourite's own game that's only the favourite, even against a 

1680 followed team: a goal against the favourite is never celebrated. 

1681 """ 

1682 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

1683 if favourite and game.involves(favourite): 

1684 return [favourite] 

1685 return [t for t in self._hockey_cfg().also_follow if game.involves(t)] 

1686 

1687 def _detect_goals(self, games: list[Game]) -> None: 

1688 """A followed team's goal: their own score increased since we last saw it. 

1689 

1690 Scoped to followed teams' own goals -- the favourite plus 

1691 ``also_follow`` (#260) -- never their opponents' or other games', 

1692 same reasoning as the power-play indicator (situation_targets): 

1693 this is a your-teams board, not a "celebrate every goal in every 

1694 game" one. A followed team playing the favourite is an opponent 

1695 there (``_celebrated_teams``). 

1696 """ 

1697 for game in games: 

1698 for team in self._celebrated_teams(game): 

1699 score = game.home.score if game.home.abbrev == team else game.away.score 

1700 previous = self._known_scores.get((game.id, team)) 

1701 self._known_scores[(game.id, team)] = score 

1702 if previous is not None and score > previous: 

1703 self._on_goal(game, team) 

1704 self._detect_opponent_goal(game) 

1705 

1706 def _detect_opponent_goal(self, game: Game) -> None: 

1707 """The favourite's opponent scored in a live game: the "wah wah" (#307). 

1708 

1709 Sound only: no goal screen, same as any non-favourite goal. Baselined 

1710 on first sighting without firing, so a restart mid-game stays quiet; 

1711 recorded under the opponent's own ``_known_scores`` key (free in the 

1712 favourite's game, where only the favourite is celebrated). Skipped 

1713 in a shootout, where the headline score only moves when it's decided. 

1714 """ 

1715 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

1716 if not favourite or not game.involves(favourite): 

1717 return 

1718 opponent = game.away if game.home.abbrev == favourite else game.home 

1719 previous = self._known_scores.get((game.id, opponent.abbrev)) 

1720 self._known_scores[(game.id, opponent.abbrev)] = opponent.score 

1721 if previous is None or opponent.score <= previous: 

1722 return 

1723 if not game.is_live or game.in_shootout: 

1724 return 

1725 log.info("Opponent goal: %s (%d)", opponent.abbrev, opponent.score) 

1726 if self._horn_muted(): 

1727 log.info("Sounds muted by button press; not playing the wah wah") 

1728 return 

1729 self.horn.play_wah_wah() 

1730 

1731 def _on_goal(self, game: Game, team: str | None = None) -> None: 

1732 """Show the goal scene; the horn is the lead team's (the favourite's, without a ranked 

1733 list), another followed team gets the ding.""" 

1734 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

1735 favourite = cfg.favourite_team 

1736 horn_team = getattr(cfg, "horn_team", favourite) 

1737 team = team or favourite 

1738 log.info( 

1739 "GOAL: %s %s %d-%d %s", 

1740 team, 

1741 game.away.abbrev, 

1742 game.away.score, 

1743 game.home.score, 

1744 game.home.abbrev, 

1745 ) 

1746 self.last_goal = (game.id, self.monotonic(), team) 

1747 if team != horn_team: 

1748 # #311: live goals only; a shootout's headline score moves when decided. 

1749 if game.is_live and not game.in_shootout: 

1750 if self._horn_muted():
