1751 log.info("Sounds muted by button press; not playing the ding") 

1752 else: 

1753 self.horn.play_ding() 

1754 return 

1755 if self._horn_muted(): 

1756 log.info("Goal horn muted by button press; not playing") 

1757 return 

1758 self.horn.play(team) 

1759 

1760 def _horn_muted(self) -> bool: 

1761 return self._horn_muted_until is not None and self.monotonic() < self._horn_muted_until 

1762 

1763 # -- physical button (#50) --------------------------------------------- 

1764 

1765 def handle_button(self) -> None: 

1766 """Act on any button presses since the last loop iteration. 

1767 

1768 The only place button presses turn into state changes: the button's 

1769 own gpiozero callbacks run on background threads and just set flags 

1770 (see button.py), so every mutation here happens on run()'s thread. 

1771 """ 

1772 if self.button is None: 

1773 return 

1774 if self.button.consume_short_press(): 

1775 minutes = self.settings.button.mute_minutes 

1776 self._horn_muted_until = self.monotonic() + minutes * 60 

1777 log.info("Button: goal horn muted for %g minutes", minutes) 

1778 if self.button.consume_long_press(): 

1779 log.info("Button: forcing next rotation") 

1780 self.advance() 

1781 

1782 # -- goal detail (#122 phase 2) --------------------------------------- 

1783 

1784 def refresh_goal_details(self) -> None: 

1785 """Poll the favourite's live game for scorer/assist detail, phase 2 of #122. 

1786 

1787 Deliberately decoupled from ``_detect_goals``: the score-increase 

1788 that drives the ``goal`` scene comes from ``score/now`` and can tick 

1789 up before ``gamecenter/{id}/landing``'s ``summary.scoring`` has 

1790 caught up with that specific goal's entry. Rather than make the 

1791 ``goal`` scene wait on data that might not be ready, this polls the 

1792 favourite's own scoring array independently and fires once a new 

1793 entry actually shows up -- possibly well after the ``goal`` scene's 

1794 own flash has already ended. 

1795 

1796 Scoped to followed teams' live games (the favourite plus 

1797 ``also_follow``, #260) and their own goals, same precedent as goal 

1798 detection and the PP indicator: one request per live followed game, 

1799 to the same landing URL ``refresh_situations()`` already polls (not 

1800 a new endpoint), on the same ``live_poll_seconds`` cadence, skipped 

1801 during intermission for the same reason situation is. 

1802 """ 

1803 for game in self._api_games(): 

1804 if game.is_live and self._is_followed(game): 

1805 self._refresh_goal_detail(game, self._celebrated_teams(game)) 

1806 

1807 def _refresh_goal_detail(self, game: Game, teams: list[str]) -> None: 

1808 now = self.monotonic() 

1809 interval = self.settings.scoreboard.live_poll_seconds 

1810 fetched_at, events = self._goal_events.get(game.id, (None, ())) 

1811 if fetched_at is not None and now - fetched_at < interval: 

1812 return 

1813 if game.in_intermission: 

1814 self._goal_events[game.id] = (now, events) 

1815 return 

1816 self.fetcher.submit( 

1817 ("goal_detail", game.id), 

1818 lambda i=game.id, t=tuple(teams): self._fetch_goal_events(i, t), 

1819 lambda r, e, i=game.id, t=now, tm=tuple(teams): self._on_goal_events(i, t, tm, r, e), 

1820 ) 

1821 

1822 def _fetch_goal_events( 

1823 self, game_id: int, teams: tuple[str, ...] 

1824 ) -> tuple[tuple[GoalEvent, ...], dict[str, dict[int, PlayerSeasonDetail]]]: 

1825 """Worker thread: the scoring array, plus the roster a new goal will need (#124). 

1826 

1827 The roster is fetched here, not when the scorer screen builds, so that 

1828 screen never waits on the network. Still lazy, as before: only when a 

1829 goal beyond the ones already shown has appeared, and only if that 

1830 team's cached roster is missing or stale. Reads the app's caches 

1831 without writing them; ``_on_goal_events`` stores the result. 

1832 """ 

1833 all_events = self.client.goal_scoring(game_id) 

1834 team_events = tuple(e for e in all_events if e.team_abbrev in teams) 

1835 rosters: dict[str, dict[int, PlayerSeasonDetail]] = {} 

1836 shown = self._shown_goal_events.get(game_id) 

1837 if shown is not None: 

1838 for event in team_events[shown : shown + 1]: 

1839 if not self._roster_fresh(event.team_abbrev): 

1840 try: 

1841 rosters[event.team_abbrev] = self.client.team_roster(event.team_abbrev) 

1842 except HockeyApiError as exc: 

1843 log.debug("Roster fetch for %s failed: %s", event.team_abbrev, exc) 

1844 return team_events, rosters 

1845 

1846 def _on_goal_events( 

1847 self, 

1848 game_id: int, 

1849 fetched_at: float, 

1850 teams: tuple[str, ...], 

1851 result: tuple[tuple[GoalEvent, ...], dict[str, dict[int, PlayerSeasonDetail]]] | None, 

1852 error: Exception | None, 

1853 ) -> None: 

1854 if error is not None or result is None: 

1855 log.debug("Goal scoring fetch for %s failed: %s", game_id, error) 

1856 team_events = self._goal_events.get(game_id, (None, ()))[1] 

1857 else: 

1858 team_events, rosters = result 

1859 for team, roster in rosters.items(): 

1860 self._team_rosters[team] = (fetched_at, roster) 

1861 self._goal_events[game_id] = (fetched_at, team_events) 

1862 self._submit( 

1863 ("goal_detail", game_id), lambda: self._detect_goal_detail(game_id, team_events) 

1864 ) 

1865 

1866 def _detect_goal_detail(self, game_id: int, events: tuple[GoalEvent, ...]) -> None: 

1867 """A followed team's scoring array grew by one entry: show it, once. 

1868 

1869 Tracks a count per game rather than matching goals by identity -- 

1870 the simplest approach that still can't refire for the same goal on 

1871 a later scorer/assist correction (the array only ever grows). 

1872 Baseline on first sighting without firing, same precedent as 

1873 ``_detect_goals``, so a game already several goals in at startup 

1874 doesn't dump a backlog of detail screens. 

1875 """ 

1876 previous = self._shown_goal_events.get(game_id) 

1877 if previous is None: 

1878 self._shown_goal_events[game_id] = len(events) 

1879 return 

1880 if len(events) > previous: 

1881 self._shown_goal_events[game_id] = previous + 1 

1882 self._goal_detail = ( 

1883 game_id, 

1884 self.monotonic(), 

1885 self._enrich_goal_detail(events[previous]), 

1886 ) 

1887 

1888 def _roster_fresh(self, team: str) -> bool: 

1889 fetched_at = self._team_rosters.get(team, (None, {}))[0] 

1890 return fetched_at is not None and self.monotonic() - fetched_at < ROSTER_TTL_SECONDS 

1891 

1892 def _team_roster(self, team: str) -> dict[int, PlayerSeasonDetail]: 

1893 """Jersey number + season points for ``team``, from the cache only (#124). 

1894 

1895 Never fetches: ``_fetch_goal_events`` fetches the roster on the worker, 

1896 lazily -- only once a new goal for that team has appeared, not 

1897 proactively for every team on the schedule -- and a failed fetch 

1898 leaves whatever was cached before (possibly still nothing), same 

1899 precedent as ``next_favourite_game``/``conference_standings``. 

1900 """ 

1901 return self._team_rosters.get(team, (None, {}))[1] 

1902 

1903 def _enrich_goal_detail(self, event: GoalEvent) -> GoalEvent: 

1904 """Fill in scorer_sweater_number/scorer_points, if the roster fetch works out. 

1905 

1906 Left as-is (both stay None) on a failed fetch or a scorer missing 

1907 from the roster response -- the screen still shows fine without 

1908 them, same graceful-degradation precedent as everything else here. 

1909 """ 

1910 detail = self._team_roster(event.team_abbrev).get(event.scorer_player_id) 

1911 if detail is None: 

1912 return event 

1913 return dataclasses.replace( 

1914 event, scorer_sweater_number=detail.sweater_number, scorer_points=detail.points 

1915 ) 

1916 

1917 # -- penalties (#340) --------------------------------------------------- 

1918 

1919 def refresh_penalties(self) -> None: 

1920 """Poll the favourite's live game for new penalties, for either team. 

1921 

1922 Same landing request and ``live_poll_seconds`` cadence as the scorer 

1923 poll (no new endpoint), skipped in intermission and the shootout. 

1924 Scoped to the favourite's own game only; an opponent's penalty is 

1925 news too, so both teams count there. 

1926 """ 

1927 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

1928 if not favourite: 

1929 return 

1930 now = self.monotonic() 

1931 interval = self.settings.scoreboard.live_poll_seconds 

1932 for game in self._api_games(): 

1933 if not game.is_live or not game.involves(favourite): 

1934 continue 

1935 fetched = self._penalty_fetched.get(game.id) 

1936 if fetched is not None and now - fetched < interval: 

1937 continue 

1938 self._penalty_fetched[game.id] = now 

1939 if game.in_intermission or game.in_shootout: 

1940 continue 

1941 self.fetcher.submit( 

1942 ("penalty", game.id), 

1943 lambda i=game.id: self.client.penalties(i), 

1944 lambda p, e, i=game.id: self._on_penalties(i, p, e), 

1945 ) 

1946 

1947 def _on_penalties( 

1948 self, game_id: int, penalties: tuple[Penalty, ...] | None, error: Exception | None 

1949 ) -> None: 

1950 if error is not None or penalties is None: 

1951 log.debug("Penalty fetch for %s failed: %s", game_id, error) 

1952 return 

1953 self._submit(("penalty", game_id), lambda: self._detect_penalties(game_id, penalties)) 

1954 

1955 def _detect_penalties(self, game_id: int, penalties: tuple[Penalty, ...]) -> None: 

1956 """Announce the newest penalty not seen before, once. 

1957 

1958 The first fetch for a game only records what is already there. If 

1959 several arrive in one poll only the last is shown; all are recorded. 

1960 """ 

1961 keys = {p.key for p in penalties} 

1962 seen = self._seen_penalties.get(game_id) 

1963 if seen is None: 

1964 self._seen_penalties[game_id] = keys 

1965 return 

1966 fresh = [p for p in penalties if p.key not in seen] 

1967 seen |= keys 

1968 if fresh: 

1969 self._penalty = (game_id, self.monotonic(), fresh[-1]) 

1970 

1971 def _penalty_override(self) -> Scene | None: 

1972 if self._penalty is None: 

1973 return None 

1974 game_id, started, penalty = self._penalty 

1975 if self.monotonic() - started >= penalty_screen.TOTAL_SECONDS: 

1976 return None 

1977 game = next((g for g in self.games if g.id == game_id), None) 

1978 if game is None or game.in_shootout or game.is_final: 

1979 return None 

1980 return Scene("penalty", game, penalty=penalty) 

1981 

1982 # -- three stars (#156) ------------------------------------------------- 

1983 

1984 def _queue_three_stars(self, game: Game, *, watched: bool) -> None: 

1985 """The favourite's game just went final: start polling for its three stars. 

1986 

1987 Called from ``refresh()``'s existing first-time-final branch (the 

1988 same one that records ``ended_at``), not a detector of its own. 

1989 Only for a game we actually watched go live -- one already final 

1990 at startup is a first sighting, and records nothing, same "baseline 

1991 without firing" precedent as goal detection, so a restart mid-hold 

1992 doesn't show the screen a second time. Favourite-only, same scoping 

1993 as goal detection and the PP indicator. 

1994 """ 

1995 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

1996 if not watched or not favourite or not game.involves(favourite): 

1997 return 

1998 if game.id not in self._three_stars_shown: 

1999 self._three_stars_pending.setdefault(game.id, None) 

2000 

2001 def refresh_three_stars(self) -> None: 

2002 """Fetch the three stars for a just-final favourite game, retrying until named. 

2003 

2004 Decoupled from the final transition itself for the same reason 

2005 ``refresh_goal_details`` is decoupled from the score increase: 

2006 ``score/now`` can flip a game to FINAL/OFF before ``landing`` has 

2007 its ``threeStars`` populated, so an empty result is retried every 

2008 ``live_poll_seconds`` rather than given up on. Stops once the stars 

2009 arrive, once the game leaves today's slate (pruned with the rest of 

2010 the per-game state), or once its final hold is over -- nothing would 

2011 show the screen after that anyway. 

2012 """ 

2013 now = self.monotonic() 

2014 interval = self.settings.scoreboard.live_poll_seconds 

2015 hold = timedelta(minutes=self.settings.scoreboard.final_hold_minutes) 

2016 for game_id, tried_at in list(self._three_stars_pending.items()): 

2017 ended = self.ended_at.get(game_id) 

2018 if game_id in self._three_stars_shown or ( 

2019 ended is not None and self.clock() - ended >= hold 

2020 ): 

2021 del self._three_stars_pending[game_id] 

2022 continue 

2023 if tried_at is not None and now - tried_at < interval: 

2024 continue 

2025 self._three_stars_pending[game_id] = now 

2026 self.fetcher.submit( 

2027 ("three_stars", game_id), 

2028 lambda i=game_id: self.client.three_stars(i), 

2029 lambda s, e, i=game_id: self._on_three_stars(i, s, e), 

2030 ) 

2031 

2032 def _on_three_stars( 

2033 self, game_id: int, stars: tuple[Star, ...] | None, error: Exception | None 

2034 ) -> None: 

2035 if error is not None: 

2036 log.debug("Three stars fetch for %s failed: %s", game_id, error) 

2037 return 

2038 if not stars or game_id in self._three_stars_shown: 

2039 return # not named yet (retried next interval), or already shown 

2040 if game_id not in self._three_stars_pending: 

2041 return # pruned or timed out while this was in flight 

2042 del self._three_stars_pending[game_id] 

2043 self._three_stars_shown.add(game_id) 

2044 self._three_stars = (game_id, self.monotonic() + self._blowout_remaining(), stars) 

2045 

2046 def _note_blowout(self, game: Game, *, watched: bool) -> None: 

2047 """Arm the blowout flash (#326) when a game we watched ends as one.""" 

2048 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2049 if ( 

2050 watched 

2051 and game.id not in self._blowout_shown 

2052 and blowout.is_blowout_loss(game, favourite) 

2053 ): 

2054 self._blowout_shown.add(game.id) 

2055 self._blowout = (game.id, self.monotonic()) 

2056 

2057 def _blowout_remaining(self) -> float: 

2058 if self._blowout is None: 

2059 return 0.0 

2060 return max(0.0, self._blowout[1] + blowout.SECONDS - self.monotonic()) 

2061 

2062 def _blowout_override(self) -> Scene | None: 

2063 if self._blowout is None or self._blowout_remaining() <= 0: 

2064 return None 

2065 game = next((g for g in self.games if g.id == self._blowout[0]), None) 

2066 return None if game is None else Scene("blowout", game) 

2067 

2068 def refresh_intermission_stats(self) -> None: 

2069 """Fetch the team stats for the favourite's game while it sits in an intermission. 

2070 

2071 Only that game, only then: one ``right-rail`` request when the intermission starts and one 

2072 a minute while it lasts (the numbers do not move without play), a failed one retried after 

2073 ``INTERMISSION_STATS_RETRY_SECONDS``. Stats for any other game are forgotten. Runs on the 

2074 fetch worker; the render loop never waits for it. 

2075 """ 

2076 game = self.favourite_game_today() 

2077 if game is None or not game.is_live or not game.in_intermission or game.in_shootout: 

2078 self._int_stats.clear() 

2079 self._int_stats_tried.clear() 

2080 return 

2081 self._int_stats = {k: v for k, v in self._int_stats.items() if k == game.id} 

2082 now = self.monotonic() 

2083 have = self._int_stats.get(game.id) 

2084 if have is not None and now - have[0] < INTERMISSION_STATS_REFRESH_SECONDS: 

2085 return 

2086 tried = self._int_stats_tried.get(game.id) 

2087 if tried is not None and now - tried < INTERMISSION_STATS_RETRY_SECONDS: 

2088 return 

2089 self._int_stats_tried[game.id] = now 

2090 self.fetcher.submit( 

2091 ("int_stats", game.id), 

2092 lambda i=game.id: self.client.game_stats(i), 

2093 lambda s, e, i=game.id: self._on_intermission_stats(i, s, e), 

2094 ) 

2095 

2096 def _on_intermission_stats( 

2097 self, game_id: int, stats: GameStats | None, error: Exception | None 

2098 ) -> None: 

2099 if error is not None or stats is None: 

2100 log.debug("Intermission stats for %s unavailable: %s", game_id, error) 

2101 return 

2102 self._int_stats[game_id] = (self.monotonic(), stats) 

2103 

2104 def _intermission_scene(self, scene: Scene) -> Scene | None: 

2105 """The stats table in place of the favourite's game scene while it is in an intermission 

2106 (nothing else is moving), once its stats have arrived; else ``None`` and the game scene 

2107 stays. The page is a pure function of the clock.""" 

2108 game = scene.game 

2109 if game is None or not game.in_intermission or game.in_shootout: 

2110 return None 

2111 if not game.involves(self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team): 

2112 return None 

2113 have = self._int_stats.get(game.id) 

2114 if have is None: 

2115 return None 

2116 stats = have[1] 

2117 if not stats.pages: 

2118 return None 

2119 # The page count is the renderer's (it depends on the panel), so this is just the tick. 

2120 tick = int(self.monotonic() // INTERMISSION_PAGE_SECONDS) 

2121 return Scene("intermission", game, stats=stats, stats_page=tick) 

2122 

2123 def _three_stars_override(self) -> Scene | None: 

2124 if self._three_stars is None: 

2125 return None 

2126 stars_game_id, shown_at, stars = self._three_stars 

2127 if self.monotonic() - shown_at >= self.settings.scoreboard.three_stars_seconds: 

2128 return None 

2129 game = next((g for g in self.games if g.id == stars_game_id), None) 

2130 if game is None: 

2131 return None 

2132 return Scene("three_stars", game, stars=stars) 

2133 

2134 # -- favourite mode -------------------------------------------------- 

2135 

2136 def favourite_game_today(self) -> Game | None: 

2137 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2138 if not favourite: 

2139 return None 

2140 return next((g for g in self.games if g.involves(favourite)), None) 

2141 

2142 def next_favourite_game(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Game | None: 

2143 """The favourite's next game from the season schedule, cached an hour. 

2144 

2145 Today's game is excluded once it is final so the board moves on to 

2146 the one after it. ``allow_fetch=False`` (used by the status page, 

2147 #61) skips the network call entirely and answers from whatever is 

2148 already cached -- the status thread must never race the main loop 

2149 into the same fetch or block on it. 

2150 """ 

2151 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2152 if not favourite: 

2153 return None 

2154 now_mono = self.monotonic() 

2155 stale = self._schedule is None or now_mono - self._schedule[0] > SCHEDULE_TTL_SECONDS 

2156 if allow_fetch and stale and now_mono >= self._schedule_retry_after: 

2157 self.fetcher.submit( 

2158 ("schedule", favourite), 

2159 lambda: self.client.schedule(favourite), 

2160 lambda s, e: self._on_schedule(favourite, now_mono, s, e), 

2161 ) 

2162 if self._schedule is None: 

2163 return None 

2164 now = self.clock() 

2165 finished = {g.id for g in self.games if g.is_final} 

2166 for game in self._schedule[1]: 

2167 if game.id in finished or game.is_final: 

2168 continue 

2169 if game.is_live or game.start_utc > now: 

2170 return game 

2171 return None 

2172 

2173 def _on_schedule( 

2174 self, team: str, fetched_at: float, games: list[Game] | None, error: Exception | None 

2175 ) -> None: 

2176 if team != self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team: 

2177 return # the favourite changed while this was in flight: it is the old team's 

2178 if error is not None or games is None: 

2179 log.warning("Schedule fetch failed: %s", error) 

2180 self._record_error(f"schedule fetch: {error}") 

2181 self._schedule_retry_after = fetched_at + SCHEDULE_TTL_SECONDS 

2182 return 

2183 self._schedule = (fetched_at, games) 

2184 

2185 def _refresh_standings(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> list[StandingsRow] | None: 

2186 """League standings, cached for ``STANDINGS_TTL_SECONDS`` like the schedule. 

2187 

2188 ``allow_fetch=False`` answers from cache only, same reasoning as 

2189 ``next_favourite_game`` -- for the status page (#61). 

2190 """ 

2191 now_mono = self.monotonic() 

2192 stale = self._standings is None or now_mono - self._standings[0] > STANDINGS_TTL_SECONDS 

2193 if allow_fetch and stale and now_mono >= self._standings_retry_after: 

2194 self.fetcher.submit( 

2195 "standings", 

2196 self.client.standings, 

2197 lambda r, e: self._on_standings(now_mono, r, e), 

2198 ) 

2199 if self._standings is None: 

2200 return None 

2201 return self._standings[1] 

2202 

2203 def _on_standings( 

2204 self, fetched_at: float, rows: list[StandingsRow] | None, error: Exception | None 

2205 ) -> None: 

2206 if error is not None or rows is None: 

2207 log.warning("Standings fetch failed: %s", error) 

2208 self._record_error(f"standings fetch: {error}") 

2209 self._standings_retry_after = fetched_at + STANDINGS_TTL_SECONDS 

2210 return 

2211 self._standings = (fetched_at, rows) 

2212 

2213 def _standings_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene | None: 

2214 """The favourite's conference neighbourhood, or None if there's nothing to show. 

2215 

2216 Suppressed entirely until the favourite has actually played a game 

2217 this season (#40): the standings endpoint keeps serving last 

2218 season's final table through the whole off-season rather than an 

2219 empty result, and ``games_played`` is the only signal available to 

2220 tell the two apart. 

2221 

2222 Deliberately does NOT also gate on ``cfg.show_standings`` here (it 

2223 used to): that field now only controls whether ``standings`` is 

2224 included in the *derived default* rotation (``_default_rotation()``, 

2225 for a board with no explicit ``[[rotation]]``) -- checking it again 

2226 in this method meant an explicit ``[[rotation]]`` entry for 

2227 ``standings`` could be silently defeated by a stale 

2228 ``show_standings`` toggle left over from before the board migrated, 

2229 which contradicts #150/#151's whole point of the rotation list 

2230 being the authoritative, admin-editable source of truth. 

2231 """ 

2232 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

2233 favourite = cfg.favourite_team 

2234 if not favourite: 

2235 return None 

2236 rows = self._refresh_standings(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2237 if not rows: 

2238 return None 

2239 favourite_row = next((r for r in rows if r.abbrev == favourite), None) 

2240 if favourite_row is None or favourite_row.games_played <= 0: 

2241 return None 

2242 window = standings_window(conference_standings(rows, favourite_row.conference), favourite) 

2243 if not window: 

2244 return None 

2245 return Scene( 

2246 "standings", 

2247 standings=tuple(window), 

2248 playoff_cut=self._line(window, playoff_cut(window)), 

2249 ) 

2250 

2251 def _conference_leaders_scene( 

2252 self, conference: str, *, allow_fetch: bool = True 

2253 ) -> Scene | None: 

2254 """The whole of one conference (#200), or None with no standings yet. 

2255 

2256 Scrolled by ``_split_slot`` over the slot's dwell. 

2257 

2258 Deliberately not gated on anyone's ``games_played``: the owner chose 

2259 to just show whatever the latest table says. 

2260 """ 

2261 rows = self._refresh_standings(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2262 if not rows: 

2263 return None 

2264 table = conference_standings(rows, conference) 

2265 if not table: 

2266 return None 

2267 return Scene( 

2268 "conference_leaders", 

2269 standings=tuple(table), 

2270 playoff_cut=self._line(table, playoff_cut(table)), 

2271 ) 

2272 

2273 @staticmethod 

2274 def _line(table: list[StandingsRow], cut: int | None) -> int | None: 

2275 """``cut`` once the season is far enough along for a playoff line (#298).""" 

2276 return cut if playoff_line_ready(table) else None 

2277 

2278 def _division_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene | None: 

2279 """The favourite's whole division (#296), or None to skip the slot. 

2280 

2281 Gated on the favourite having played, like ``standings``: the API 

2282 serves last season's final table all through the off-season. 

2283 """ 

2284 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2285 if not favourite: 

2286 return None 

2287 rows = self._refresh_standings(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2288 if not rows: 

2289 return None 

2290 favourite_row = next((r for r in rows if r.abbrev == favourite), None) 

2291 if favourite_row is None or favourite_row.games_played <= 0: 

2292 return None 

2293 table = division_standings(rows, favourite_row.division) 

2294 if not table: 

2295 return None 

2296 cut = DIVISION_SPOTS if len(table) > DIVISION_SPOTS else None 

2297 return Scene("division", standings=tuple(table), playoff_cut=self._line(table, cut)) 

2298 

2299 def _wildcard_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene | None: 

2300 """The favourite's conference wild-card race (#298), or None to skip the slot. 

2301 

2302 Gated on the favourite having played, like ``standings``/``division``. 

2303 """ 

2304 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2305 if not favourite: 

2306 return None 

2307 rows = self._refresh_standings(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2308 if not rows: 

2309 return None 

2310 favourite_row = next((r for r in rows if r.abbrev == favourite), None) 

2311 if favourite_row is None or favourite_row.games_played <= 0: 

2312 return None 

2313 table = wildcard_standings(rows, favourite_row.conference) 

2314 if not table: 

2315 return None 

2316 cut = WILDCARD_SPOTS if len(table) > WILDCARD_SPOTS else None 

2317 return Scene("wildcard", standings=tuple(table), playoff_cut=self._line(table, cut)) 

2318 

2319 def _refresh_season_series( 

2320 self, game_id: int, *, allow_fetch: bool = True 

2321 ) -> SeasonSeriesRecord | None: 

2322 """The upcoming game's head-to-head tally, cached ``SEASON_SERIES_TTL_SECONDS``. 

2323 

2324 Same TTL + backoff-on-failure shape as ``_refresh_standings``, keyed 

2325 by game id since the answer is specific to one matchup. A failed 

2326 refresh keeps serving whatever was cached before it. 

2327 """ 

2328 now_mono = self.monotonic() 

2329 entry = self._season_series.get(game_id) 

2330 stale = entry is None or now_mono - entry[0] > SEASON_SERIES_TTL_SECONDS 

2331 retry_after = self._season_series_retry_after.get(game_id, 0.0) 

2332 key = ("season_series", game_id) 

2333 if allow_fetch and stale and now_mono >= retry_after and not self.fetcher.pending(key): 

2334 # Only ever the one upcoming matchup worth remembering. 

2335 self._season_series = {k: v for k, v in self._season_series.items() if k == game_id} 

2336 self._season_series_retry_after = {} 

2337 self.fetcher.submit( 

2338 key, 

2339 lambda: self.client.season_series(game_id), 

2340 lambda r, e: self._on_season_series(game_id, now_mono, r, e), 

2341 ) 

2342 entry = self._season_series.get(game_id) 

2343 return entry[1] if entry is not None else None 

2344 

2345 def _on_season_series( 

2346 self, 

2347 game_id: int, 

2348 fetched_at: float, 

2349 record: SeasonSeriesRecord | None, 

2350 error: Exception | None, 

2351 ) -> None: 

2352 if error is not None: 

2353 log.warning("Season series fetch for %s failed: %s", game_id, error) 

2354 self._record_error(f"season series fetch: {error}") 

2355 self._season_series_retry_after[game_id] = fetched_at + SEASON_SERIES_TTL_SECONDS 

2356 return 

2357 self._season_series[game_id] = (fetched_at, record) 

2358 

2359 def _matchup_scene(self, upcoming: Game | None, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene | None: 

2360 """The favourite's head-to-head record against their next opponent (#157). 

2361 

2362 None -- skipped for this rotation pass, never drawn blank -- with no 

2363 upcoming game, before the fetch has succeeded, or when the API had 

2364 no usable tally. A ``0-0`` tally (preseason, or no meeting finished 

2365 yet) is a real answer and does render. 

2366 """ 

2367 if upcoming is None: 

2368 return None 

2369 record = self._refresh_season_series(upcoming.id, allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2370 if record is None: 

2371 return None 

2372 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2373 meetings = tuple( 

2374 result for m in record.meetings if (result := m.result_for(favourite)) is not None 

2375 ) 

2376 return Scene("matchup", upcoming, season_series=record, meetings=meetings) 

2377 

2378 def _split_slot(self, scene: Scene, offset: float, seconds: float) -> Scene: 

2379 """One rotation slot's scene at ``offset`` seconds into its ``seconds`` dwell.""" 

2380 if scene.kind == "scores": 

2381 return self._page_scores(scene, offset, seconds) 

2382 if scene.kind in SCROLLING_KINDS: 

2383 return self._scroll_conference(scene, offset, seconds) 

2384 return self._split_matchup(scene, offset, seconds) 

2385 

2386 def _slot_seconds(self, scene: Scene, configured: float) -> float: 

2387 """A scrolling table's slot lasts as long as a readable scroll needs. 

2388 

2389 The configured seconds is a minimum there, not an exact length. 

2390 """ 

2391 if scene.kind not in SCROLLING_KINDS: 

2392 return configured 

2393 return self.renderer.standings_scroll_seconds(len(scene.standings), configured) 

2394 

2395 def _scroll_conference(self, scene: Scene, offset: float, seconds: float) -> Scene: 

2396 """Scroll the conference table down over the slot's dwell.""" 

2397 r = self.renderer 

2398 rows = len(scene.standings) 

2399 px = r.standings_scroll_px(rows, offset, seconds) 

2400 hold = min(r.SCROLL_HOLD_SECONDS, seconds / 4) 

2401 moving = r.standings_scroll_range(rows) > 0 and hold <= offset < seconds - hold 

2402 return dataclasses.replace(scene, scroll_px=px, scrolling=moving) 

2403 

2404 def _page_scores(self, scene: Scene, offset: float, seconds: float) -> Scene: 

2405 """The ``scores`` slot's dwell is shared evenly by its grid pages (#269).""" 

2406 per_page = self.renderer.scores_per_page() 

2407 pages = math.ceil(len(scene.games) / per_page) 

2408 page = min(pages - 1, int(offset * pages / seconds)) 

2409 return dataclasses.replace( 

2410 scene, games=scene.games[page * per_page : (page + 1) * per_page] 

2411 ) 

2412 

2413 @staticmethod 

2414 def _split_matchup(scene: Scene, offset: float, seconds: float) -> Scene: 

2415 """The second half of a matchup slot shows the meetings behind the tally (#168). 

2416 

2417 One rotation entry, by the owner's choice, rather than a second 

2418 screen to configure. With no finished meeting yet (a 0-0 tally) the 

2419 tally keeps the whole slot. 

2420 """ 

2421 if scene.kind != "matchup" or not scene.meetings or offset < seconds / 2: 

2422 return scene 

2423 return dataclasses.replace(scene, kind="matchup_meetings") 

2424 

2425 def _refresh_leaders(self, team: str, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> TeamLeaders | None: 

2426 """The favourite's stat leaders, cached ``LEADERS_TTL_SECONDS`` like standings. 

2427 

2428 A cache for a different team counts as stale, so a live favourite 

2429 switch never shows the old team's players. A failed refresh keeps 

2430 serving what was cached for the same team. 

2431 """ 

2432 now_mono = self.monotonic() 

2433 entry = self._leaders 

2434 if entry is not None and entry[0] != team: 

2435 entry = self._leaders = None 

2436 stale = entry is None or now_mono - entry[1] > LEADERS_TTL_SECONDS 

2437 if allow_fetch and stale and now_mono >= self._leaders_retry_after: 

2438 self.fetcher.submit( 

2439 ("club_stats", team), 

2440 lambda: self.client.club_stats(team), 

2441 lambda r, e: self._on_club_stats(team, now_mono, r, e), 

2442 ) 

2443 entry = self._leaders 

2444 if entry is not None and entry[0] != team: 

2445 entry = None 

2446 return entry[2] if entry is not None else None 

2447 

2448 def _on_club_stats( 

2449 self, team: str, fetched_at: float, stats: ClubStats | None, error: Exception | None 

2450 ) -> None: 

2451 if team != self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team: 

2452 return # the favourite changed while this was in flight 

2453 if error is not None or stats is None: 

2454 log.warning("Club stats fetch failed: %s", error) 

2455 self._record_error(f"club stats fetch: {error}") 

2456 self._leaders_retry_after = fetched_at + LEADERS_TTL_SECONDS 

2457 return 

2458 self._leaders = (team, fetched_at, team_leaders(stats, self._rng)) 

2459 

2460 def _leaders_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene | None: 

2461 """The favourite's top players (#201), or None (skipped, never blank). 

2462 

2463 None with no favourite, before the first fetch lands, or while the 

2464 API's arrays are empty (pre-season). There's deliberately no minimum 

2465 games-played floor: early on everyone sits at zero and a random 

2466 leader is shown rather than hiding the screen. 

2467 """ 

2468 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

2469 if not favourite: 

2470 return None 

2471 leaders = self._refresh_leaders(favourite, allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2472 if leaders is None: 

2473 return None 

2474 return Scene("leaders", leaders=leaders) 

2475 

2476 def _countdown_or_preview(self, upcoming: Game) -> Scene: 

2477 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

2478 if upcoming.seconds_until_start(self.clock()) <= cfg.countdown_hours * 3600: 

2479 return Scene("countdown", upcoming) 

2480 return Scene("preview", upcoming) 

2481 

2482 def _default_rotation(self) -> list[RotationEntry]: 

2483 """The implicit rotation list, derived from the older discrete settings (#150). 

2484 

2485 Used whenever ``[[rotation]]`` isn't present in the config file, so 

2486 an upgraded board's idle rotation is unchanged until the owner 

2487 opts into an explicit list. ``matchup`` (#157) is deliberately never 

2488 here: it only appears when someone lists it in ``[[rotation]]``. 

2489 """ 

2490 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

2491 entries = [RotationEntry("countdown_preview", cfg.rotate_seconds)] 

2492 if cfg.show_standings: 

2493 entries.append(RotationEntry("standings", cfg.rotate_seconds)) 

2494 if cfg.show_clock_between_games: 

2495 entries.append(RotationEntry("clock", cfg.rotate_seconds)) 

2496 return entries 

2497 

2498 def _unified_rotation(self) -> list[RotationEntry]: 

2499 """The one idle rotation, both sports' screens: the configured ``[[rotation]]`` list, else 

2500 each sport's default in the order of the lead teams' ranks.""" 

2501 if self.settings.rotation: 

2502 return list(self.settings.rotation) 

2503 order = self._priority().sports() or ["hockey", "football"] 

2504 rows: list[RotationEntry] = [] 

2505 for sport in order: 

2506 if sport == "hockey": 

2507 rows += self._default_rotation() 

2508 else: 

2509 rows += [RotationEntry(s, sec) for s, sec in DEFAULT_FOOTBALL_ROTATION] 

2510 return rows 

2511 

2512 def _sport_rotation(self, sport: str) -> list[RotationEntry]: 

2513 """The rows ``sport`` shows: its current segment's while the sports alternate, else its own 

2514 screens (and the clock) of the one list, else its default.""" 

2515 if sport in self._segment_rows: 

2516 return list(self._segment_rows[sport]) 

2517 if self.settings.rotation: 

2518 rows = [ 

2519 e for e in self.settings.rotation if screen_sport(e.screen) in (sport, "shared") 

2520 ] 

2521 if rows: 

2522 return rows 

2523 if sport == "hockey": 

2524 return self._default_rotation() 

2525 return [RotationEntry(s, sec) for s, sec in DEFAULT_FOOTBALL_ROTATION] 

2526 

2527 def _effective_rotation(self) -> list[RotationEntry]: 

2528 return self._sport_rotation("hockey") 

2529 

2530 def _rotation_screen_scene( 

2531 self, 

2532 screen: str, 

2533 upcoming: Game | None, 

2534 standings: Scene | None, 

2535 *, 

2536 allow_fetch: bool = True, 

2537 ) -> Scene | None: 

2538 if screen == "countdown_preview": 

2539 return self._countdown_or_preview(upcoming) if upcoming is not None else None 

2540 if screen == "standings": 

2541 return standings 

2542 if screen == "clock": 

2543 return Scene("clock") 

2544 if screen in ("top_west", "top_east"): 

2545 # Resolved here so a board not listing them never needs the fetch. 

2546 conference = "W" if screen == "top_west" else "E" 

2547 return self._conference_leaders_scene(conference, allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2548 if screen == "division": 

2549 return self._division_scene(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2550 if screen == "wildcard": 

2551 return self._wildcard_scene(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2552 if screen == "matchup": 

2553 # Resolved here, not up front like standings, so a board without 

2554 # "matchup" in its rotation never calls right-rail at all. 

2555 return self._matchup_scene(upcoming, allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2556 if screen == "leaders": 

2557 # Resolved lazily like matchup: club-stats is never called unless listed. 

2558 return self._leaders_scene(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2559 if screen == "holiday": 

2560 return self._holiday_screen_scene() 

2561 if screen == "address": 

2562 return self._address_scene() 

2563 if screen == "scores_grid": 

2564 return Scene("scores", games=tuple(self.games)) if self.games else None 

2565 return None 

2566 

2567 def _holiday_screen_scene(self) -> Scene | None: 

2568 """The active holiday's own screen (#243), or None to skip the slot. 

2569 

2570 Two have one: the turkey, Nov 1 through US Thanksgiving Day, and the tree, Dec 1-25. 

2571 Each needs Holiday Cheer on and its own theme ticked -- the same switches as its 

2572 overlay -- and the two windows never overlap. 

2573 """ 

2574 cfg = self.settings.holiday 

2575 if not cfg.enabled: 

2576 return None 

2577 today = self.clock().astimezone(self.tz).date() 

2578 if "thanksgiving" in cfg.themes and thanksgiving_countdown(today): 

2579 return Scene("thanksgiving") 

2580 if "christmas" in cfg.themes and christmas_countdown(today): 

2581 return Scene("christmas_tree") 

2582 return None 

2583 

2584 def _rotate_idle_scenes( 

2585 self, upcoming: Game | None, standings: Scene | None, *, allow_fetch: bool = True 

2586 ) -> Scene | None: 

2587 """Cycle the configured (or derived-default) rotation list, each entry its own dwell time. 

2588 

2589 A configured entry with nothing to show right now -- ``standings`` 

2590 before the favourite's season has started, or ``countdown_preview`` 

2591 with no upcoming game at all -- is skipped for this pass rather than 

2592 shown blank (#150 decision 2); the remaining entries keep cycling 

2593 normally. ``None`` only when every entry is currently unavailable. 

2594 """ 

2595 slots = [ 

2596 (scene, self._slot_seconds(scene, entry.seconds)) 

2597 for entry in self._effective_rotation() 

2598 if ( 

2599 scene := self._rotation_screen_scene( 

2600 entry.screen, upcoming, standings, allow_fetch=allow_fetch 

2601 ) 

2602 ) 

2603 is not None 

2604 ] 

2605 if not slots: 

2606 return None 

2607 clock = self.monotonic() - self._idle_origin 

2608 if len(slots) == 1: 

2609 scene, seconds = slots[0] 

2610 return self._split_slot(scene, clock % seconds, seconds) 

2611 total = sum(seconds for _, seconds in slots) 

2612 position = clock % total 

2613 start = 0.0 

2614 for scene, seconds in slots: 

2615 if position < start + seconds: 

2616 return self._split_slot(scene, position - start, seconds) 

2617 start += seconds 

2618 return slots[-1][0] 

2619 

2620 def select_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene: 

2621 """Decide what to show; the draw step only renders the answer. 

2622 

2623 ``allow_fetch=False`` (the status page, #61) must never trigger a 

2624 network call or mutate ``_schedule``/``_standings``/``last_error`` 

2625 from the status thread -- that would race the main loop into 

2626 duplicate fetches, or block a "read-only" page on a slow hockey 

2627 response. 

2628 

2629 wifi_join wins over even ap_setup (#133): while a join attempt's 

2630 outcome is still showing, that's more current than "here's how to 

2631 join" -- notably during a failed attempt's retry window, when 

2632 scoreboard-setup-ap has already brought the AP (and its own 

2633 ap_setup state file) back up underneath the "Failed..." message 

2634 that's still counting down. 

2635 

2636 ap_setup otherwise wins over everything else, unconditionally 

2637 (#131 follow-up): if the board's own WiFi AP is up, a phone joining 

2638 it is the only way to reach the board at all -- there is no point 

2639 showing a stale game, a goal flash, or "NO DATA" to nobody. 

2640 """ 

2641 join_scene = self._wifi_join_scene() 

2642 if join_scene is not None: 

2643 return join_scene 

2644 ap_scene = self._ap_setup_scene() 

2645 if ap_scene is not None: 

2646 return ap_scene 

2647 if self._address_until is not None and self.monotonic() < self._address_until: 

2648 address_scene = self._address_scene() 

2649 if address_scene is not None: 

2650 return address_scene 

2651 if self._sport == "football" and self._football is not None: 

2652 return self._football.scene() 

2653 scene = self._select_base_scene(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

2654 return self._apply_goal_override(scene) 

2655 

2656 def _wifi_join_scene(self) -> Scene | None: 

2657 try: 

2658 raw = self.wifi_join.outcome_path.read_text() 

2659 except FileNotFoundError: 

2660 return None 

2661 except OSError as exc: 

2662 log.warning("Could not read WiFi join outcome file: %s", exc) 

2663 return None 

2664 try: 

2665 data = json.loads(raw) 

2666 status = str(data["status"]) 

2667 ssid = str(data["ssid"]) 

2668 except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc: 

2669 log.warning("Malformed WiFi join outcome file: %s", exc) 

2670 return None 

2671 return Scene("wifi_join", wifi_join_status=status, wifi_join_ssid=ssid) 

2672 

2673 def _ap_setup_scene(self) -> Scene | None: 

2674 try: 

2675 raw = self.ap_setup_state_path.read_text() 

2676 except FileNotFoundError: 

2677 return None 

2678 except OSError as exc: 

2679 log.warning("Could not read AP setup state file: %s", exc) 

2680 return None 

2681 try: 

2682 data = json.loads(raw) 

2683 ssid = str(data["ssid"]) 

2684 password = data["password"] 

2685 password = str(password) if password is not None else None 

2686 except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc: 

2687 log.warning("Malformed AP setup state file: %s", exc) 

2688 return None 

2689 return Scene( 

2690 "ap_setup", 

2691 ap_ssid=ssid, 

2692 ap_password=password, 

2693 ap_qr_matrix=self._ap_setup_qr_matrix(ssid, password), 

2694 ) 

2695 

2696 def _ap_setup_qr_matrix( 

2697 self, ssid: str, password: str | None 

2698 ) -> tuple[tuple[bool, ...], ...] | None: 

2699 cache_key = (ssid, password) 

2700 if self._ap_qr_cache is not None and self._ap_qr_cache[0] == cache_key: 

2701 return self._ap_qr_cache[1] 

2702 if password is None: 

2703 payload = f"WIFI:T:nopass;S:{_qr_escape(ssid)};;" 

2704 else: 

2705 payload = f"WIFI:T:WPA;S:{_qr_escape(ssid)};P:{_qr_escape(password)};;" 

2706 matrix = self._qr_matrix(payload, "AP setup") 

2707 self._ap_qr_cache = (cache_key, matrix) 

2708 return matrix 

2709 

2710 @staticmethod 

2711 def _qr_matrix(payload: str, what: str) -> tuple[tuple[bool, ...], ...] | None: 

2712 try: 

2713 # border=0 explicitly: verified live that get_matrix() otherwise 

2714 # includes the library's own default 4-module quiet zone in its 

2715 # output (29x29 modules for this payload becomes 37x37 with it) 

2716 # -- silently exceeding the panel's 32px height and skipping the 

2717 # QR draw entirely, with nothing wrong to log because nothing 

2718 # raised. Confirming the fit still happens in the renderer 

2719 # regardless; this just stops the default border from being the 

2720 # reason it doesn't. 

2721 qr = qrcode.QRCode(error_correction=qrcode.constants.ERROR_CORRECT_L, border=0) 

2722 qr.add_data(payload) 

2723 qr.make(fit=True) 

2724 return tuple(tuple(bool(v) for v in row) for row in qr.get_matrix()) 

2725 except Exception as exc: 

2726 log.warning("Could not build %s QR code: %s", what, exc) 

2727 return None 

2728 

2729 # -- Admin page address (#293) ----------------------------------------- 

2730 

2731 def _build_admin(self) -> AdminServer | None: 

2732 """The admin server for the current settings (not started). 

2733 

2734 Normally on ``status.port`` plus the ``alias_port`` listener. While the 

2735 WiFi setup page holds port 80 (``_admin_yielded``) it is on the alias 

2736 port alone, or off if that is disabled -- the setup page is what a 

2737 phone on the AP needs then, and both can't have the port. 

2738 """ 

2739 cfg = self.settings.status 

2740 if not cfg.enabled: 

2741 return None 

2742 port, alias = cfg.port, cfg.alias_port 

2743 if self._admin_yielded: 

2744 if not cfg.alias_port: 

2745 return None 

2746 port, alias = cfg.alias_port, 0 

2747 return AdminServer( 

2748 config_path=str(self.settings.source_path or DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATHS[0]), 

2749 port=port, 

2750 snapshot=self.status_snapshot, 

2751 demo_setter=self.set_demo_mode, 

2752 mirror=self.mirror, 

2753 alias_port=alias, 

2754 cache_items=self.cache_items, 

2755 cache_clearer=self.request_cache_clear, 

2756 ) 

2757 

2758 def _set_admin_yield(self, yielded: bool) -> None: 

2759 """Hand port 80 to (or take it back from) the WiFi setup page (#292). 

2760 

2761 Must stop the admin listener before the setup server binds, and 

2762 rebuild it only after the setup server has released the port. 

2763 """ 

2764 if yielded == self._admin_yielded or not self._admin_owned: 

2765 return 

2766 if self.admin_server is not None: 

2767 self.admin_server.stop() 

2768 self._admin_yielded = yielded 

2769 self.admin_server = self._build_admin() 

2770 if self.admin_server is not None and self._running: 

2771 self.admin_server.start() 

2772 

2773 def _board_name(self) -> str | None: 

2774 """``<hostname>.local`` for the panel and status page, None if unknown.""" 

2775 name = self._hostname_lookup().strip().lower() 

2776 return f"{name}.local" if valid_hostname_label(name) else None 

2777 

2778 def _sync_alias(self) -> None: 

2779 """Keep plain ``scoreboard.local`` published while it's free (#292).""" 

2780 if self.alias_publisher is None: 

2781 return 

2782 cfg = self.settings.status 

2783 own = self._hostname_lookup().strip().lower() 

2784 wanted = cfg.enabled and cfg.local_alias and own != "scoreboard" 

2785 self.alias_publisher.sync(wanted, self._current_ip()) 

2786 

2787 def _current_ip(self) -> str | None: 

2788 now = self.monotonic() 

2789 if self._ip_cache is None or now - self._ip_cache[0] >= IP_CACHE_SECONDS: 

2790 self._ip_cache = (now, self._ip_lookup()) 

2791 return self._ip_cache[1] 

2792 

2793 def _track_address(self) -> None: 

2794 """Start the address screen's minute when the board first gets online. 

2795 

2796 Keyed on "has a default route" (the same test the setup-AP script 

2797 uses), not on the Wi-Fi join state, so an Ethernet-only boot gets it 

2798 too. Mutates state, so only run()'s own loop calls it, never the 

2799 admin server's status thread. 

2800 """ 

2801 has_ip = self._current_ip() is not None 

2802 if has_ip and not self._had_ip: 

2803 self._address_until = self.monotonic() + ADDRESS_SHOW_SECONDS 

2804 self._had_ip = has_ip 

2805 

2806 def _address_scene(self) -> Scene | None: 

2807 """Where to reach the admin page, or None with no address or no page. 

2808 

2809 The name (``<name>.local``, #292) leads and the IP is the fallback for 

2810 a device that can't resolve it. The QR always carries the IP URL. 

2811 """ 

2812 cfg = self.settings.status 

2813 ip = self._current_ip() 

2814 if not cfg.enabled or ip is None: 

2815 return None 

2816 url = f"http://{ip}" if cfg.port == 80 else f"http://{ip}:{cfg.port}" 

2817 if self._address_qr_cache is None or self._address_qr_cache[0] != url: 

2818 self._address_qr_cache = (url, self._qr_matrix(url, "admin address")) 

2819 return Scene( 

2820 "address", 

2821 address_ip=ip, 

2822 address_port=cfg.port, 

2823 address_qr=self._address_qr_cache[1], 

2824 address_name=self._board_name(), 

2825 ) 

2826 

2827 # -- WiFi setup page (#132) -------------------------------------------- 

2828 

2829 def _sync_setup_server(self) -> None: 

2830 """Start/stop the WiFi setup HTTP server in step with the AP state file. 

2831 

2832 Only called from run()'s own loop -- status_snapshot() (the admin 

2833 server's own thread) only ever calls select_scene(allow_fetch=False), 

2834 never this, so there is no cross-thread race to start or stop the 

2835 same socket. Only needs "is the AP state file there", the same 

2836 signal _ap_setup_scene keys off of, not its contents. Also reacts to 

2837 a live config reload (wifi_setup.enabled/port) even when the AP 

2838 state file's presence hasn't changed, the same way _apply_reloaded_ 

2839 settings handles the admin server's own port change. 

2840 """ 

2841 cfg = self.settings.wifi_setup 

2842 wanted = cfg.enabled and self.ap_setup_state_path.exists() 

2843 desired = (cfg.enabled, cfg.port) if wanted else None 

2844 if desired == self._setup_server_config: 

2845 return 

2846 if self.setup_server is not None: 

2847 self.setup_server.stop() 

2848 self.setup_server = None 

2849 self._setup_server_config = desired 

2850 # Port 80 is shared by name only: the admin page steps back to its 

2851 # alias port while the setup page runs, and returns after (#292). 

2852 self._set_admin_yield( 

2853 desired is not None and cfg.port == self.settings.status.port, 

2854 ) 

2855 if desired is None: 

2856 # The AP setup flow is over (WiFi joined, or setup disabled) -- 

2857 # any hardware_mapping trial (#172) belongs to this session 

2858 # only. A later AP session on the same boot (WiFi drops hours 

2859 # later) must not inherit a stale "still testing" gate from one 

2860 # that already ended. 

2861 self.hw_mapping_trial_path.unlink(missing_ok=True) 

2862 return 

2863 self.setup_server = SetupServer( 

2864 networks=self._cached_setup_networks, 

2865 on_submit=self._on_setup_submission, 

2866 port=cfg.port, 

2867 panel_state=self._panel_check_state, 

2868 on_panel_confirm=self._on_panel_confirm, 

2869 on_panel_next=self._on_panel_next, 

2870 ) 

2871 try: 

2872 self.setup_server.start() 

2873 except OSError as exc: 

2874 log.warning("Could not start WiFi setup server: %s", exc) 

2875 self.setup_server = None 

2876 

2877 def _cached_setup_networks(self) -> list[str]: 

2878 """The nearby-network snapshot scoreboard-setup-ap cached before AP mode came up.""" 

2879 try: 

2880 raw = self.ap_scan_state_path.read_text() 

2881 except OSError: 

2882 return [] 

2883 try: 

2884 data = json.loads(raw) 

2885 except json.JSONDecodeError as exc: 

2886 log.warning("Malformed AP scan state file: %s", exc) 

2887 return [] 

2888 if not isinstance(data, list): 

2889 return [] 

2890 return [str(item) for item in data] 

2891 

2892 def _on_setup_submission(self, ssid: str, password: str | None) -> None: 

2893 """Record a WiFi choice from the setup page for #133's join flow to pick up. 

2894 

2895 This app never touches iwd/iwctl itself -- see setup_server.py's own 

2896 module docstring for why actually joining the network is out of 

2897 scope here. Written atomically (tmp + replace), same convention as 

2898 Settings.save(), so a reader never sees a half-written file. 

2899 """ 

2900 payload = json.dumps({"ssid": ssid, "password": password}) 

2901 tmp_path = self.ap_submission_state_path.with_name( 

2902 self.ap_submission_state_path.name + ".tmp" 

2903 ) 

2904 try: 

2905 tmp_path.write_text(payload) 

2906 tmp_path.replace(self.ap_submission_state_path) 

2907 except OSError as exc: 

2908 log.warning("Could not write WiFi setup submission: %s", exc) 

2909 

2910 # -- display check (#172) ---------------------------------------------- 

2911 

2912 def _panel_check_state(self) -> tuple[str, bool, bool]: 

2913 """(configured hardware_mapping, whether a trial is unconfirmed, 

2914 whether every candidate has now been tried) -- read by SetupServer's 

2915 GET / to render the display check card.""" 

2916 tried = self._tried_mappings() 

2917 tried_all = tried is not None and set(PANEL_HARDWARE_MAPPING_CHOICES) <= set(tried) 

2918 return (self.settings.panel.hardware_mapping, tried is not None, tried_all) 

2919 

2920 def _tried_mappings(self) -> list[str] | None: 

2921 """The mappings this trial has tried, or None with no trial running. 

2922 

2923 An unreadable marker still counts as a trial (the gate must hold) 

2924 that has only tried the current mapping. 

2925 """ 

2926 try: 

2927 raw = self.hw_mapping_trial_path.read_text() 

2928 except FileNotFoundError: 

2929 return None 

2930 except OSError: 

2931 return [self.settings.panel.hardware_mapping] 

2932 try: 

2933 tried = json.loads(raw) 

2934 except json.JSONDecodeError: 

2935 tried = None 

2936 if not isinstance(tried, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in tried): 

2937 return [self.settings.panel.hardware_mapping] 

2938 return tried 

2939 

2940 def _on_panel_next(self, chosen: str | None = None) -> str | None: 

2941 """ "No, try the next option" (or a board picked by name): save that 

2942 mapping and restart so the panel actually picks it up, returning it 

2943 on success. ``chosen`` must be one of the documented choices. 

2944 

2945 The trial marker is written *before* the mapping changes: if it 

2946 can't be, nothing changes and nothing restarts, rather than leaving 

2947 a new mapping in place with no gate and no "is it working?" card. 

2948 

2949 A throwaway Settings instance, not self.settings -- same reasoning 

2950 as admin_server.py's saves: mutating the live app's Settings from 

2951 this HTTP-handling thread while the main loop is mid-iteration 

2952 reading it would be an undefined interleaving, and it is moot anyway 

2953 once the restart below lands, since the new process loads settings 

2954 from disk itself. 

2955 """ 

2956 if self.settings.source_path is None: 

2957 log.warning("No config file loaded; cannot try a different hardware_mapping") 

2958 return None 

2959 if chosen is not None and chosen not in PANEL_HARDWARE_MAPPING_CHOICES: 

2960 log.warning("Ignoring unknown hardware_mapping %r from the setup page", chosen) 

2961 return None 

2962 current = self.settings.panel.hardware_mapping 

2963 new_mapping = chosen or next_hardware_mapping(current) 

2964 previous = self._tried_mappings() 

2965 tried = [*(previous or [current]), new_mapping] 

2966 try: 

2967 self.hw_mapping_trial_path.write_text(json.dumps(tried)) 

2968 except OSError as exc: 

2969 log.warning("Could not write hardware_mapping trial marker: %s", exc) 

2970 return None 

2971 try: 

2972 Settings.from_toml(self.settings.source_path).save( 

2973 {"panel": {"hardware_mapping": new_mapping}} 

2974 ) 

2975 except (OSError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError, ConfigWriteError) as exc: 

2976 log.warning("Could not save hardware_mapping %r: %s", new_mapping, exc) 

2977 self._restore_trial_marker(previous) 

2978 return None 

2979 self._restart_service() 

2980 return new_mapping 

2981 

2982 def _restore_trial_marker(self, previous: list[str] | None) -> None: 

2983 """Put the marker back as it was before a save that didn't happen.""" 

2984 try: 

2985 if previous is None: 

2986 self.hw_mapping_trial_path.unlink(missing_ok=True) 

2987 else: 

2988 self.hw_mapping_trial_path.write_text(json.dumps(previous)) 

2989 except OSError as exc: 

2990 log.warning("Could not restore hardware_mapping trial marker: %s", exc) 

2991 

2992 def _on_panel_confirm(self) -> None: 

2993 """ "Yes, it's working": end the trial, ungating the WiFi form.""" 

2994 self.hw_mapping_trial_path.unlink(missing_ok=True) 

2995 

2996 def _select_base_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene: 

2997 if self.last_success is None: 

2998 return Scene("connecting") 

2999 if self.is_stale(): 

3000 return Scene("no_data") 

3001 scene = self._favourite_scene(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

3002 if scene is not None: 

3003 return scene 

3004 if self._scores_grid_fallback(): 

3005 per_page = self.renderer.scores_per_page() 

3006 return Scene("scores", games=tuple(self.games[self.index : self.index + per_page])) 

3007 if self.games: 

3008 return Scene("game", self.games[self.index]) 

3009 return Scene("clock" if self.settings.scoreboard.show_clock_when_idle else "no_games") 

3010 

3011 def _apply_goal_override(self, scene: Scene) -> Scene: 

3012 """Show the goal (or later, goal_detail) screen for a followed team's goal. 

3013 

3014 Only ever replaces a "game" scene -- never a countdown, preview or 

3015 other idle screen. The red zone (#260): while followed teams' live 

3016 games take turns on screen, a goal in any of them jumps straight to 

3017 that game, whichever one is up -- and so do the favourite's three 

3018 stars, or a live followed game's turn could swallow them. A game no followed team is in 

3019 (today's-games rotation) is never interrupted. 

3020 For a followed team's goal, goal_detail wins when both are pending: 

3021 it fires strictly after the goal scene's own score-increase trigger 

3022 (see refresh_goal_details), so by the time it is ready there is no 

3023 point re-showing the plain "GOAL" + score flash for the same goal. 

3024 The favourite's goal is the exception: its animated goal light is the 

3025 celebration, so it plays its full goal_flash_seconds and the scorer 

3026 screen follows it (see _goal_detail_override). The scorer is usually 

3027 ready within seconds, which used to cut the light to about 2s (#338). 

3028 

3029 three_stars (#156) is the last layer: it only arms once the game is 

3030 final, so it's temporally disjoint from the other two in practice. 

3031 If a late game-winner's flash does overlap it, the goal screens win 

3032 and three_stars just loses that slice of its own window. 

3033 """ 

3034 if scene.kind != "game" or not self._is_followed(scene.game): 

3035 return scene 

3036 if scene.game.in_shootout: 

3037 # The headline score only moves when a shootout is decided, so a 

3038 # favourite "goal" here is really the win: the horn already 

3039 # played (_on_goal), but GOAL would cover the final grid. 

3040 stars = self._three_stars_override() 

3041 return stars if stars is not None else scene 

3042 detail = self._goal_detail_override() 

3043 if detail is not None: 

3044 return detail 

3045 if self.last_goal is not None: 

3046 goal_game_id, goal_time, goal_team = self.last_goal 

3047 goal_game = next((g for g in self.games if g.id == goal_game_id), None) 

3048 if ( 

3049 goal_game is not None 

3050 and not goal_game.in_shootout # a shootout win, not a goal (#259) 

3051 and self.monotonic() - goal_time < self.settings.scoreboard.goal_flash_seconds 

3052 ): 

3053 return Scene("goal", goal_game, goal_team=goal_team) 

3054 penalty = self._penalty_override() 

3055 if penalty is not None: 

3056 return penalty 

3057 flash = self._blowout_override() 

3058 if flash is not None: 

3059 return flash 

3060 stars = self._three_stars_override() 

3061 if stars is not None: 

3062 return stars 

3063 return self._intermission_scene(scene) or scene 

3064 

3065 def _goal_detail_override(self) -> Scene | None: 

3066 if self._goal_detail is None: 

3067 return None 

3068 detail_game_id, detail_time, event = self._goal_detail 

3069 now = self.monotonic() 

3070 start = detail_time 

3071 light_end = self._goal_light_end(detail_game_id) 

3072 if light_end is not None and detail_time < light_end: 

3073 # The favourite's goal light plays its whole window first; the 

3074 # scorer screen then gets its own full window from the light's end. 

3075 if now < light_end: 

3076 return None 

3077 start = light_end 

3078 if now - start >= self.settings.scoreboard.goal_detail_seconds: 

3079 return None 

3080 game = next((g for g in self.games if g.id == detail_game_id), None) 

3081 if game is None or game.in_shootout: 

3082 return None 

3083 return Scene("goal_detail", game, goal_event=event) 

3084 

3085 def _goal_light_end(self, game_id: int) -> float | None: 

3086 """When the favourite's animated goal light in ``game_id`` ends 

3087 (monotonic), or ``None`` if the last goal there wasn't the favourite's. 

3088 

3089 Only the favourite's goal is held ahead of the scorer screen: a 

3090 followed team's goal is a quick static flash (#260), which the scorer 

3091 screen still replaces as soon as it is ready.""" 

3092 if self.last_goal is None: 

3093 return None 

3094 goal_game_id, goal_time, goal_team = self.last_goal 

3095 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

3096 if goal_game_id != game_id or not favourite or goal_team != favourite: 

3097 return None 

3098 return goal_time + self.settings.scoreboard.goal_flash_seconds 

3099 

3100 def _favourite_scene(self, *, allow_fetch: bool = True) -> Scene | None: 

3101 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

3102 turns = self._followed_turns() 

3103 if turns: 

3104 position = self.monotonic() % sum(seconds for _, seconds in turns) 

3105 for game, seconds in turns: 

3106 if position < seconds: 

3107 return self._turn_scene(game) 

3108 position -= seconds 

3109 return self._turn_scene(turns[-1][0]) 

3110 if not cfg.favourite_team: 

3111 return None 

3112 today = self.favourite_game_today() 

3113 upcoming = ( 

3114 today 

3115 if today is not None and today.is_pregame 

3116 else self.next_favourite_game(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

3117 ) 

3118 standings = self._standings_scene(allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

3119 return self._rotate_idle_scenes(upcoming, standings, allow_fetch=allow_fetch) 

3120 

3121 def _turn_scene(self, game: Game) -> Scene: 

3122 """A turn's screen: a game not yet started is its countdown/preview.""" 

3123 return self._countdown_or_preview(game) if game.is_pregame else Scene("game", game) 

3124 

3125 def _followed_turns(self) -> list[tuple[Game, float]]: 

3126 """Which followed games are on screen now, each with its dwell in seconds. 

3127 

3128 Primary-first, by the owner's call on #260: while the favourite is 

3129 live and the puck is in play, its game holds the screen alone -- 

3130 other followed teams only appear when they score (the red zone, 

3131 ``_apply_goal_override``). During the favourite's intermission, or 

3132 while its final is held (``final_hold_minutes``, with its three 

3133 stars), the other live followed games take ``rotate_seconds`` 

3134 turns, and the favourite's own screen drops in for a quick 

3135 ``FAVOURITE_QUICK_TURN`` share of that each cycle so its score stays 

3136 in view. With the favourite not playing, live followed games take 

3137 equal turns. An ``also_follow`` team's game leaves the cycle the 

3138 moment it ends; only the favourite's final is held. 

3139 """ 

3140 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

3141 today = self.favourite_game_today() 

3142 favourite_game = None 

3143 if today is not None and today.is_live: 

3144 if not today.in_intermission: 

3145 return [(today, cfg.rotate_seconds)] 

3146 favourite_game = today 

3147 elif today is not None and today.is_final: 

3148 ended = self.ended_at.get(today.id) 

3149 if ended is not None and self.clock() - ended < timedelta( 

3150 minutes=cfg.final_hold_minutes 

3151 ): 

3152 favourite_game = today 

3153 others = [ 

3154 (g, cfg.rotate_seconds) 

3155 for g in self.games 

3156 if g.is_live and g is not today and self._is_followed(g) 

3157 ] 

3158 if favourite_game is None and today is not None and today.is_pregame and others: 

3159 # A followed team already live must not erase the favourite's 

3160 # countdown/preview for the hours before puck drop. 

3161 favourite_game = today 

3162 if favourite_game is None: 

3163 return others 

3164 return [(favourite_game, cfg.rotate_seconds * FAVOURITE_QUICK_TURN), *others] 

3165 

3166 def situation_targets(self) -> list[Game]: 

3167 """Live games worth a second request: followed teams' and the on-screen one. 

3168 

3169 Everything else shows even strength; that is the trade for not 

3170 hammering the landing endpoint once per live game every poll. 

3171 """ 

3172 targets = [g for g in self._api_games() if g.is_live and self._is_followed(g)] 

3173 if self._index_game_on_screen(): 

3174 current = self._api_game(self.games[self.index]) 

3175 if current.is_live and current not in targets: 

3176 targets.append(current) 

3177 return targets 

3178 

3179 def _index_game_on_screen(self) -> bool: 

3180 """Whether ``games[index]`` is the game being drawn (the one-at-a-time fallback). 

3181 

3182 Not when the grid shows (no per-game situation), nor while a 

3183 favourite/followed flow or the idle rotation owns the screen: those 

3184 never read ``index``, so polling for it is wasted NHL traffic. 

3185 """ 

3186 if not self.games or self._scores_grid_fallback(): 

3187 return False 

3188 return self._favourite_scene(allow_fetch=False) is None 

3189 

3190 def _api_game(self, game: Game) -> Game: 

3191 """The API's current view of a (possibly delayed) game.""" 

3192 return next((g for g in self._api_games() if g.id == game.id), game) 

3193 

3194 def refresh_situations(self) -> None: 

3195 now = self.monotonic() 

3196 interval = self.settings.scoreboard.live_poll_seconds 

3197 wanted = {g.id: g for g in self.situation_targets()} 

3198 for game_id in list(self.situations): 

3199 if game_id not in wanted: 

3200 del self.situations[game_id] 

3201 self._shown_situations.pop(game_id, None) 

3202 for game_id, game in wanted.items(): 

3203 fetched_at = self.situations.get(game_id, (None, None))[0] 

3204 if fetched_at is not None and now - fetched_at < interval: 

3205 continue 

3206 if game.in_intermission or game.in_shootout: 

3207 # No special teams in a shootout; refresh_shootouts() owns it. 

3208 self.situations[game_id] = (now, None) 

3209 self._submit( 

3210 ("situation", game_id), lambda i=game_id: self._show_situation(i, None) 

3211 ) 

3212 continue 

3213 self.fetcher.submit( 

3214 ("situation", game_id), 

3215 lambda i=game_id: self.client.situation(i), 

3216 lambda s, e, i=game_id, t=now: self._on_situation(i, t, s, e), 

3217 ) 

3218 

3219 def _on_situation( 

3220 self, game_id: int, fetched_at: float, situation: Situation | None, error: Exception | None 

3221 ) -> None: 

3222 if error is not None: 

3223 log.debug("Situation fetch for %s failed: %s", game_id, error) 

3224 situation = self.situations.get(game_id, (None, None))[1] 

3225 self.situations[game_id] = (fetched_at, situation) 

3226 self._submit( 

3227 ("situation", game_id), lambda i=game_id, s=situation: self._show_situation(i, s) 

3228 ) 

3229 

3230 def _show_situation(self, game_id: int, situation: Situation | None) -> None: 

3231 self._shown_situations[game_id] = situation 

3232 

3233 def shootout_targets(self) -> list[Game]: 

3234 """Shootout games to track: followed teams' and the on-screen one (#259, #260). 

3235 

3236 Same scoping as situation_targets. A finished game stays a target 

3237 until one fetch has landed after it ended, so the grid ends on the 

3238 deciding shot rather than the last poll before the final horn. 

3239 """ 

3240 candidates = [g for g in self._api_games() if self._is_followed(g)] 

3241 if self._index_game_on_screen(): 

3242 candidates.append(self._api_game(self.games[self.index])) 

3243 targets: list[Game] = [] 

3244 for game in candidates: 

3245 if game in targets or not game.in_shootout: 

3246 continue 

3247 if game.is_live or (game.is_final and not self._shootout_settled(game)): 

3248 targets.append(game) 

3249 return targets 

3250 

3251 def _shootout_settled(self, game: Game) -> bool: 

3252 entry = self.shootouts.get(game.id) 

3253 return entry is not None and entry[2] 

3254 

3255 def refresh_shootouts(self) -> None: 

3256 """Fetch each tracked shootout every ``shootout_poll_seconds`` (#259). 

3257 

3258 A failed fetch keeps the last good grid on screen, like situations. 

3259 """ 

3260 now = self.monotonic() 

3261 interval = self.settings.scoreboard.shootout_poll_seconds 

3262 current = {g.id for g in self._api_games()} 

3263 for game_id in list(self.shootouts): 

3264 if game_id not in current: 

3265 del self.shootouts[game_id] 

3266 self._shown_shootouts.pop(game_id, None) 

3267 for game_id in list(self._shootout_seen): 

3268 if game_id not in current: 

3269 del self._shootout_seen[game_id] 

3270 for game in self.shootout_targets(): 

3271 previous = self.shootouts.get(game.id, (None, None, False)) 

3272 if previous[0] is not None and now - previous[0] < interval: 

3273 continue 

3274 self.fetcher.submit( 

3275 ("shootout", game.id), 

3276 lambda i=game.id: self.client.shootout(i), 

3277 lambda s, e, i=game.id, t=now, final=game.is_final: self._on_shootout( 

3278 i, t, final, s, e 

3279 ), 

3280 ) 

3281 

3282 def _on_shootout( 

3283 self, 

3284 game_id: int, 

3285 fetched_at: float, 

3286 is_final: bool, 

3287 shootout: Shootout | None, 

3288 error: Exception | None, 

3289 ) -> None: 

3290 if error is not None: 

3291 log.debug("Shootout fetch for %s failed: %s", game_id, error) 

3292 previous = self.shootouts.get(game_id, (None, None, False)) 

3293 self.shootouts[game_id] = (fetched_at, previous[1], previous[2]) 

3294 return 

3295 self.shootouts[game_id] = (fetched_at, shootout, is_final) 

3296 self._submit(("shootout", game_id), lambda i=game_id, s=shootout: self._show_shootout(i, s)) 

3297 

3298 def _show_shootout(self, game_id: int, shootout: Shootout | None) -> None: 

3299 self._shown_shootouts[game_id] = shootout 

3300 self._note_shootout_attempts(game_id, shootout, self.monotonic()) 

3301 

3302 def _note_shootout_attempts(self, game_id: int, shootout: Shootout | None, now: float) -> None: 

3303 """Stamp each attempt with when we first saw it (#259). 

3304 

3305 The first successful fetch for a game is the baseline: whatever is 

3306 already there is marked ``None`` and never animates, same rule as 

3307 goal detection. The stamp is poll arrival, but the animation is 

3308 driven by the age against the clock at render time, so the 5s poll 

3309 cadence doesn't show up as stutter. 

3310 """ 

3311 seen = self._shootout_seen.get(game_id) 

3312 baseline = seen is None 

3313 if seen is None: 

3314 seen = self._shootout_seen[game_id] = {} 

3315 for attempt in shootout.attempts if shootout is not None else (): 

3316 if attempt.sequence not in seen: 

3317 seen[attempt.sequence] = None if baseline else now 

3318 

3319 def shootout_ages(self, game_id: int) -> dict[int, float]: 

3320 """Seconds since each still-animating attempt first appeared.""" 

3321 now = self.monotonic() 

3322 window = self.renderer.SHOOTOUT_ANIM_SECONDS 

3323 ages = {} 

3324 for sequence, stamp in self._shootout_seen.get(game_id, {}).items(): 

3325 if stamp is not None and 0 <= now - stamp < window: 

3326 ages[sequence] = now - stamp 

3327 return ages 

3328 

3329 def with_situation(self, game: Game) -> Game: 

3330 situation = self._shown_situations.get(game.id) 

3331 if situation is not None: 

3332 game = dataclasses.replace(game, situation=situation) 

3333 data = self._shown_shootouts.get(game.id) 

3334 if data is not None and game.shootout is None: 

3335 if self.april_fools_active(): 

3336 data = april_fools.swap_shootout(data) 

3337 game = dataclasses.replace(game, shootout=data) 

3338 return game 

3339 

3340 def order(self, games: list[Game]) -> list[Game]: 

3341 """Sort live-first, then optionally pin the favourite team to the front. 

3342 

3343 The sort is repeated here rather than trusted from the client so that 

3344 display order is a property of the app, not of whoever fetched. 

3345 """ 

3346 games = sorted(games, key=Game.sort_key) 

3347 favourite = self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team 

3348 if not (favourite and self.settings.scoreboard.prefer_favourite): 

3349 return games 

3350 pinned = [g for g in games if g.involves(favourite)] 

3351 rest = [g for g in games if not g.involves(favourite)] 

3352 return pinned + rest 

3353 

3354 def poll_interval(self) -> float: 

3355 """Poll harder while a game is actually in progress.""" 

3356 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

3357 games = self._api_games() 

3358 if any(g.is_live and g.in_shootout for g in games): 

3359 return min(cfg.shootout_poll_seconds, cfg.live_poll_seconds) 

3360 if any(g.is_live and not g.in_intermission for g in games): 

3361 return cfg.live_poll_seconds 

3362 return cfg.poll_seconds 

3363 

3364 def _scores_grid_fallback(self) -> bool: 

3365 """Whether today's games cycle as grid pages rather than one at a time (#269). 

3366 

3367 A single game keeps the full game scene: a grid of one is just a 

3368 smaller version of it. 

3369 """ 

3370 return self.settings.scoreboard.scores_grid and len(self.games) > 1 

3371 

3372 def advance(self) -> None: 

3373 if not self.games: 

3374 return 

3375 if self._scores_grid_fallback(): 

3376 # index is the first game of the current page. 

3377 per_page = self.renderer.scores_per_page() 

3378 pages = math.ceil(len(self.games) / per_page) 

3379 self.index = (self.index // per_page + 1) % pages * per_page 

3380 return 

3381 self.index = (self.index + 1) % len(self.games) 

3382 

3383 # -- output ---------------------------------------------------------- 

3384 

3385 def is_stale(self) -> bool: 

3386 if self.last_success is None: 

3387 return True 

3388 return (self.monotonic() - self.last_success) > STALE_AFTER_SECONDS 

3389 

3390 # -- status page (#48) ------------------------------------------------ 

3391 

3392 # -- the admin page's Cache tab ---------------------------------------------------- 

3393 

3394 def cache_items(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]: 

3395 """Everything cached, hockey's and football's, for the admin page to show (read-only; it 

3396 runs on the admin thread, so it only copies what is already in memory).""" 

3397 from .cache_view import item 

3398 

3399 now = self.monotonic() 

3400 out: list[dict[str, Any]] = [] 

3401 if self._standings is not None: 

3402 at, rows = self._standings 

3403 out.append( 

3404 item( 

3405 "hockey:standings", "hockey", "Standings", now - at, f"{len(rows)} teams", rows 

3406 ) 

3407 ) 

3408 if self._schedule is not None: 

3409 at, games = self._schedule 

3410 out.append( 

3411 item( 

3412 "hockey:schedule", 

3413 "hockey", 

3414 f"{self._hockey_cfg().favourite_team or 'favourite'} season schedule", 

3415 now - at, 

3416 f"{len(games)} games", 

3417 games, 

3418 ) 

3419 ) 

3420 for game_id, (at, record) in sorted(dict(self._season_series).items()): 

3421 out.append( 

3422 item( 

3423 f"hockey:season_series:{game_id}", 

3424 "hockey", 

3425 f"Season series, game {game_id}", 

3426 now - at, 

3427 "no tally" if record is None else "head-to-head tally", 

3428 record, 

3429 ) 

3430 ) 

3431 if self._leaders is not None: 

3432 team, at, leaders = self._leaders 

3433 out.append( 

3434 item( 

3435 "hockey:leaders", 

3436 "hockey", 

3437 f"{team} leaders", 

3438 now - at, 

3439 "none" if leaders is None else "goals, points, goalies", 

3440 leaders, 

3441 ) 

3442 ) 

3443 for team, (at, roster) in sorted(dict(self._team_rosters).items()): 

3444 out.append( 

3445 item( 

3446 f"hockey:rosters:{team}", 

3447 "hockey", 

3448 f"{team} roster", 

3449 now - at, 

3450 f"{len(roster)} players", 

3451 roster, 

3452 ) 

3453 ) 

3454 if self._football is not None: 

3455 out += self._football.cache_items() 

3456 return out 

3457 

3458 def request_cache_clear(self, scope: str) -> bool: 

3459 """Clear a scope of the cache (``all``, ``hockey``, ``football`` or one item's key). 

3460 

3461 Called from the admin thread, so it only leaves a note: hockey's caches are cleared by the 

3462 render thread, football's by its feed worker (which owns them). Returns whether the scope 

3463 is one this board has.""" 

3464 from .cache_view import valid_scope 

3465 

3466 keys = [i["key"] for i in self.cache_items()] 

3467 if not valid_scope(scope, keys): 

3468 return False 

3469 self._cache_clears.add(scope) 

3470 return True 

3471 

3472 def _apply_cache_clears(self) -> None: 

3473 if not self._cache_clears: 

3474 return 

3475 from .cache_view import matches 

3476 

3477 scopes, self._cache_clears = set(self._cache_clears), set() 

3478 

3479 def wanted(key: str) -> bool: 

3480 return any(matches(s, key) for s in scopes) 

3481 

3482 # An item key names one thing; clearing it clears its kind (a team's roster, say). 

3483 def kind(prefix: str) -> bool: 

3484 return wanted(prefix) or any(s.startswith(prefix + ":") for s in scopes) 

3485 

3486 if kind("hockey:standings"): 

3487 self._standings, self._standings_retry_after = None, 0.0 

3488 if kind("hockey:schedule"): 

3489 self._schedule, self._schedule_retry_after = None, 0.0 

3490 if kind("hockey:season_series"): 

3491 self._season_series, self._season_series_retry_after = {}, {} 

3492 if kind("hockey:leaders"): 

3493 self._leaders, self._leaders_retry_after = None, 0.0 

3494 if kind("hockey:rosters"): 

3495 self._team_rosters = {} 

3496 log.info("Cache cleared: %s", ", ".join(sorted(scopes))) 

3497 if self._football is not None: 

3498 for scope in scopes: 

3499 if scope in ("all", "football") or scope.startswith("football:"): 

3500 self._football.request_clear(scope) 

3501 

3502 def status_snapshot(self) -> dict[str, str]: 

3503 """Everything the admin page's status box shows -- state already 

3504 sitting in memory. 

3505 

3506 Called from the admin server's own thread (#61, #178 story 10): 

3507 must never trigger a network fetch or mutate shared state 

3508 concurrently with the main loop, hence ``allow_fetch=False`` -- a 

3509 slow hockey response must not block a "read-only" status view, and 

3510 the two threads must not race into duplicate fetches. 

3511 """ 

3512 scene = self.select_scene(allow_fetch=False) 

3513 return { 

3514 "version": installed_version() or "unknown (factory image)", 

3515 "address": self._board_name() or "(unknown)", 

3516 "demo mode": "on" if self._demo_mode else "off", 

3517 "scene": "demo" if self._demo_mode else scene.kind, 

3518 "current game": self._scene_game_label(scene), 

3519 **self._hockey_status(), 

3520 **self._football_status(), 

3521 } 

3522 

3523 def _hockey_status(self) -> dict[str, str]: 

3524 """The hockey half of the status box, always shown and labelled.""" 

3525 cfg = self._hockey_cfg() 

3526 return { 

3527 "Hockey favourite team": cfg.favourite_team or "(none)", 

3528 "Hockey also following": ", ".join(cfg.also_follow) or "(none)", 

3529 "Hockey last successful poll": self._format_time(self.last_success_at), 

3530 "Hockey last error": self.last_error or "(none)", 

3531 "Hockey last error at": self._error_time_label() or "(none)", 

3532 **self._fetch_status(), 

3533 } 

3534 

3535 def _fetch_status(self) -> dict[str, str]: 

3536 """The fetch worker's health (#267): a slow or hung API shows up here.""" 

3537 stats = self.fetcher.stats() 

3538 if not stats.threaded: 

3539 return {"Hockey fetch worker": "inline (no worker)"} 

3540 if stats.in_flight and stats.oldest_age is not None: 

3541 worker = f"busy: {stats.in_flight} in flight, oldest {stats.oldest_age:.0f}s" 

3542 else: 

3543 worker = "idle" 

3544 if stats.last_seconds is None: 

3545 last = "(none yet)" 

3546 else: 

3547 outcome = "ok" if stats.last_ok else "failed" 

3548 last = f"{stats.last_label}, {stats.last_seconds:.1f}s, {outcome}" 

3549 return { 

3550 "Hockey fetch worker": worker, 

3551 "Hockey last fetch": last, 

3552 "Hockey fetch totals": ( 

3553 f"{stats.completed} done, {stats.failed} failed, " 

3554 f"{stats.slow} slow (over {SLOW_FETCH_SECONDS:.0f}s)" 

3555 ), 

3556 } 

3557 

3558 def _football_status(self) -> dict[str, str]:
