3559 """The football half of the status box, always shown and labelled (#352). 

3560 

3561 The worker's snapshot times are monotonic, so they are turned into wall-clock times here. 

3562 Before football's mode exists (no football team ranked on a hockey-only board) the 

3563 feed fields say so rather than vanish. 

3564 """ 

3565 cfg = self._football_cfg() 

3566 base = { 

3567 "Football favourite team": cfg.favourite_team or "(none)", 

3568 "Football also following": ", ".join(cfg.also_follow) or "(none)", 

3569 } 

3570 if self._football is None: 

3571 off = "(football not running)" 

3572 return { 

3573 **base, 

3574 "Football last successful poll": off, 

3575 "Football last error": off, 

3576 "Football last error at": off, 

3577 } 

3578 snap = self._football.snapshot 

3579 

3580 def wall(mono: float | None) -> datetime | None: 

3581 if mono is None: 

3582 return None 

3583 return self.clock() - timedelta(seconds=self.monotonic() - mono) 

3584 

3585 failed_at = wall(snap.last_error_at) if snap is not None else None 

3586 return { 

3587 **base, 

3588 "Football last successful poll": self._format_time( 

3589 wall(snap.fetched_at) if snap else None 

3590 ), 

3591 "Football last error": (snap.last_error if snap else "") or "(none)", 

3592 "Football last error at": self._format_time(failed_at) if failed_at else "(none)", 

3593 } 

3594 

3595 def _error_time_label(self) -> str: 

3596 if self.last_error_at is None: 

3597 return "" 

3598 label = self._format_time(self.last_error_at) 

3599 if self.last_error_recovered_at is not None: 

3600 recovered = self.last_error_recovered_at.astimezone(self.tz).strftime("%H:%M:%S") 

3601 label += f" (recovered {recovered})"

3644 def _begin_frame(self, key: object) -> None: 

3645 """Snapshot this frame for the live view (#268) if what it shows 

3646 (``key``: the scene and everything else that decides its pixels) 

3647 differs from the last snapshot, or one was asked for. A frame in the 

3648 middle of an animation waits for it to finish, so a fly-by or a 

3649 shootout pop-in isn't frozen half-drawn; ``key`` stays unrecorded 

3650 until then, so the change isn't missed. The clock's ticking time 

3651 isn't in ``key``: the page's Refresh is for that.""" 

3652 mirror = self.mirror 

3653 if not mirror.watching and not mirror.requested: 

3654 self._mirror_key = None 

3655 return 

3656 if key == self._mirror_key and not mirror.requested: 

3657 return 

3658 if ( 

3659 self._overlay_animating 

3660 or self._shootout_animating 

3661 or self._scroll_animating 

3662 or self._goal_building 

3663 or self._fb_animating 

3664 or self._penalty_building 

3665 ): 

3666 return 

3667 mirror.requested = False 

3668 self._mirror_key = key 

3669 self.canvas = MirrorCanvas(unwrap(self.canvas), mirror) 

3670 

3671 def swap_canvas(self) -> None: 

3672 """Show the frame just drawn, publishing it first if it was a 

3673 live-view snapshot (see _begin_frame).""" 

3674 if isinstance(self.canvas, MirrorCanvas): 

3675 self.mirror.publish(self._applied_brightness, self.clock()) 

3676 self.canvas = self.matrix.SwapOnVSync(unwrap(self.canvas))

3683 @staticmethod 

3684 def _april_fools_scene(scene: Scene) -> Scene: 

3685 """Every NSH label in ``scene`` as MIL; nothing else changes (#248).""" 

3686 changes: dict[str, object] = {} 

3687 if scene.game is not None: 

3688 changes["game"] = april_fools.swap_game(scene.game) 

3689 if scene.goal_event is not None: 

3690 changes["goal_event"] = april_fools.swap_goal(scene.goal_event) 

3691 if scene.goal_team: 

3692 changes["goal_team"] = april_fools.rename(scene.goal_team) 

3693 if scene.penalty is not None: 

3694 changes["penalty"] = dataclasses.replace( 

3695 scene.penalty, team_abbrev=april_fools.rename(scene.penalty.team_abbrev) 

3696 ) 

3697 if scene.stars is not None: 

3698 changes["stars"] = tuple(april_fools.swap_star(s) for s in scene.stars) 

3699 if scene.standings is not None: 

3700 changes["standings"] = april_fools.swap_rows(scene.standings) 

3701 if scene.games: 

3702 changes["games"] = tuple(april_fools.swap_game(g) for g in scene.games) 

3703 return dataclasses.replace(scene, **changes) if changes else scene

3847 def _shootout_frame_ages(self, game: Game) -> dict[int, float]: 

3848 if self._demo_drawing: 

3849 # The demo has no polls: its newest attempt "appears" when the 

3850 # step starts, so the animation is visible on every pass. 

3851 started = self._demo_shootout_started 

3852 if started is None or game.shootout is None or not game.shootout.attempts: 

3853 return {} 

3854 age = self.monotonic() - started 

3855 newest = game.shootout.attempts[-1].sequence 

3856 return {newest: age} if age < self.renderer.SHOOTOUT_ANIM_SECONDS else {} 

3857 return self.shootout_ages(game.id)

3862 if not cfg.enabled:

3866 def _football_game_holiday(self, scene: Scene, season: Holiday | None) -> Holiday | None: 

3867 """The holiday to draw over a football scene (#430). 

3868 

3869 A **game screen** (the field, the plays, the countdown, the preview, the final...) gets a 

3870 decoration only for a Thanksgiving or Christmas game, by the game's own date in the board's 

3871 zone, and only when that holiday is ticked; no other holiday touches it, whatever the 

3872 calendar says. Every other football scene (the clock, the standings...) keeps the season's. 

3873 """ 

3874 from .football.idle_views import game_holiday 

3875 

3876 if scene.kind not in FOOTBALL_GAME_SCENES: 

3877 return season 

3878 start = None 

3879 if scene.fb_game is not None: 

3880 start = scene.fb_game.start_utc 

3881 elif scene.fb_idle is not None: 

3882 start = getattr(scene.fb_idle, "start_utc", None) 

3883 name = game_holiday(start, self.tz) 

3884 cfg = self.settings.holiday 

3885 if name is None or not cfg.enabled or name not in cfg.themes: 

3886 return None 

3887 return HOLIDAYS.get(name)

3889 def _draw_holiday_overlay(self, scene: Scene, favourite: str) -> None: 

3890 holiday = self._demo_holiday if self._demo_drawing else self.active_holiday() 

3891 football_on = self._sport == "football" and self._football is not None 

3892 if football_on and not self._demo_drawing: 

3893 holiday = self._football_game_holiday(scene, holiday) 

3894 min_gap, max_gap = self.settings.holiday.flyby_gap_minutes 

3895 sport, favourite = self._colour_scheme(favourite) 

3896 with use_sport(sport): 

3897 self._overlay_animating = self.holiday_overlay.draw( 

3898 self.canvas, 

3899 scene_kind=scene.kind, 

3900 holiday=holiday, 

3901 now=self.monotonic(), 

3902 width=self.renderer.width, 

3903 height=self.renderer.height, 

3904 min_gap_seconds=min_gap * 60, 

3905 max_gap_seconds=max_gap * 60, 

3906 day=self.clock().astimezone(self.tz).date(), 

3907 favourite=favourite, 

3908 )
